38// Finite repeat coordinates only need the fractional IEEE-754 bits.
39static double realimage_repeat_fraction(double value)
40{
41 if constexpr (sizeof(double) != sizeof(uint64_t) ||
42 !std::numeric_limits<double>::is_iec559 ||
43 std::numeric_limits<double>::digits != 53 ||
44 std::numeric_limits<double>::max_exponent != 1024)
45 return std::fmod(value, 1.0);
46 uint64_t bits;
47 std::memcpy(&bits, &value, sizeof(bits));
48 const unsigned exponent = unsigned((bits >> 52) & 0x7ff);
49 if (exponent < 1023)
50 return value;
51 if (exponent >= 1075)
52 return 0;
53 bits &= ~((uint64_t(1) << (1075 - exponent)) - 1);
54 double integral;
55 std::memcpy(&integral, &bits, sizeof(integral));
56 return value - integral;
57}

71static REALIMAGE_INLINE __m128i realimage_texture2(__m128d s, __m128d t, const uint8_t* texture,
72 uint32_t base, uint32_t width, uint32_t height, unsigned row_shift)
73{
74 auto repeat = [](__m128d q) {
75 const __m128d magnitude = _mm_andnot_pd(_mm_set1_pd(-0.0), q);
76 if (_mm_movemask_pd(_mm_cmplt_pd(magnitude, _mm_set1_pd(1.0))) == 3)
77 return q;
78 if (_mm_movemask_pd(_mm_cmplt_pd(magnitude, _mm_set1_pd(2147483648.0))) == 3)
79 return _mm_sub_pd(q, _mm_cvtepi32_pd(_mm_cvttpd_epi32(q)));
80 return _mm_set_pd(realimage_repeat_fraction(_mm_cvtsd_f64(_mm_unpackhi_pd(q, q))),
81 realimage_repeat_fraction(_mm_cvtsd_f64(q)));
82 };
83 const __m128d u = _mm_sub_pd(_mm_mul_pd(repeat(s), _mm_set1_pd(width)), _mm_set1_pd(0.5)),
84 v = _mm_sub_pd(_mm_mul_pd(repeat(t), _mm_set1_pd(height)), _mm_set1_pd(0.5));
85 auto floor_int = [](__m128d q) {
86 const __m128i truncated = _mm_cvttpd_epi32(q);
87 const __m128i below = _mm_castpd_si128(_mm_cmplt_pd(q, _mm_cvtepi32_pd(truncated)));
88 return _mm_sub_epi32(truncated, _mm_and_si128(
89 _mm_shuffle_epi32(below, _MM_SHUFFLE(3, 1, 2, 0)), _mm_set1_epi32(1)));
90 };
91 const __m128i x = floor_int(u), y = floor_int(v);
92 const __m128d fx = _mm_sub_pd(u, _mm_cvtepi32_pd(x)), fy = _mm_sub_pd(v, _mm_cvtepi32_pd(y));
93 const __m128i xmask = _mm_set1_epi32(width - 1), ymask = _mm_set1_epi32(height - 1);
94 const __m128i x0 = _mm_slli_epi32(_mm_and_si128(x, xmask), 1),
95 y0 = _mm_sll_epi32(_mm_and_si128(y, ymask), _mm_cvtsi32_si128(row_shift)),
96 y1 = _mm_sll_epi32(_mm_and_si128(_mm_add_epi32(y, _mm_set1_epi32(1)), ymask), _mm_cvtsi32_si128(row_shift));
97 __m128i p00, p10, p01, p11;
98 if (!(_mm_movemask_epi8(_mm_cmpeq_epi32(x0, _mm_set1_epi32((width - 1) * 2))) & 255))
99 {
100 auto pair = [&](__m128i yy) {
101 const __m128i at = _mm_add_epi32(_mm_set1_epi32(base), _mm_add_epi32(x0, yy));
102 const unsigned a = unsigned(_mm_cvtsi128_si32(at)), b = unsigned(_mm_cvtsi128_si32(_mm_srli_si128(at, 4)));
103 uint32_t first, second;
104 std::memcpy(&first, texture + a, 4);
105 std::memcpy(&second, texture + b, 4);
106 return _mm_set_epi32(0, 0, second, first);
107 };
108 const __m128i top = pair(y0), bottom = pair(y1), mask = _mm_set1_epi32(65535);
109 p00 = _mm_and_si128(top, mask);
110 p10 = _mm_srli_epi32(top, 16);
111 p01 = _mm_and_si128(bottom, mask);
112 p11 = _mm_srli_epi32(bottom, 16);
113 }
114 else
115 {
116 const __m128i x1 = _mm_slli_epi32(_mm_and_si128(_mm_add_epi32(x, _mm_set1_epi32(1)), xmask), 1);
117 auto texel = [&](__m128i xx, __m128i yy) {
118 const __m128i at = _mm_add_epi32(_mm_set1_epi32(base), _mm_add_epi32(xx, yy));
119 const unsigned a = unsigned(_mm_cvtsi128_si32(at)), b = unsigned(_mm_cvtsi128_si32(_mm_srli_si128(at, 4)));
120 uint16_t first, second;
121 std::memcpy(&first, texture + a, 2);
122 std::memcpy(&second, texture + b, 2);
123 return _mm_set_epi32(0, 0, second, first);
124 };
125 p00 = texel(x0, y0);
126 p10 = texel(x1, y0);
127 p01 = texel(x0, y1);
128 p11 = texel(x1, y1);
129 }
130 auto channel = [&](unsigned shift, uint32_t mask) {
131 const __m128i shifts = _mm_cvtsi32_si128(shift), masks = _mm_set1_epi32(mask);
132 auto expand = [&](const __m128i p) {
133 return _mm_cvtepi32_pd(_mm_and_si128(_mm_srl_epi32(p, shifts), masks));
134 };
135 const __m128d a = expand(p00), b = expand(p10), c = expand(p01), d = expand(p11);
136 const __m128d top = _mm_add_pd(a, _mm_mul_pd(fx, _mm_sub_pd(b, a))),
137 bottom = _mm_add_pd(c, _mm_mul_pd(fx, _mm_sub_pd(d, c)));
138 const __m128d color = _mm_mul_pd(_mm_add_pd(top,
139 _mm_mul_pd(fy, _mm_sub_pd(bottom, top))), _mm_set1_pd(255));
140 return _mm_cvttpd_epi32(color);
141 };
142 const __m128i red = channel(11, 31), green = channel(5, 63), blue = channel(0, 31);
143 const __m128i numerators = _mm_packs_epi32(_mm_unpacklo_epi64(red, green), blue);
144 // Unsigned factors 33826 (R/B) and 16645 (G) preserve integral RGB thresholds.
145 const __m128i colors = _mm_srli_epi16(_mm_mulhi_epu16(numerators,
146 _mm_set_epi16(0, 0, -31710, -31710, 16645, 16645, -31710, -31710)), 4);
147 const __m128i rg = _mm_unpacklo_epi16(colors, _mm_setzero_si128()),
148 b = _mm_unpackhi_epi16(colors, _mm_setzero_si128());
149 return _mm_or_si128(_mm_slli_epi32(rg, 16),
150 _mm_or_si128(_mm_slli_epi32(_mm_srli_si128(rg, 8), 8), b));
151}
152static __m128i realimage_texture2_exact(__m128d s, __m128d t, const uint8_t* texture,
153 uint32_t base, uint32_t width, uint32_t height, unsigned row_shift)
154{
155 return realimage_texture2(s, t, texture, base, width, height, row_shift);
156}

164static REALIMAGE_INLINE RealImageTextureCoordinates2 realimage_texture_coordinates2(
165 __m128d s, __m128d t, uint32_t width, uint32_t height)
166{
167 auto repeat = [](__m128d q) {
168 const __m128d magnitude = _mm_andnot_pd(_mm_set1_pd(-0.0), q);
169 if (_mm_movemask_pd(_mm_cmplt_pd(magnitude, _mm_set1_pd(1.0))) == 3)
170 return q;
171 if (_mm_movemask_pd(_mm_cmplt_pd(magnitude, _mm_set1_pd(2147483648.0))) == 3)
172 return _mm_sub_pd(q, _mm_cvtepi32_pd(_mm_cvttpd_epi32(q)));
173 return _mm_set_pd(realimage_repeat_fraction(_mm_cvtsd_f64(_mm_unpackhi_pd(q, q))),
174 realimage_repeat_fraction(_mm_cvtsd_f64(q)));
175 };
176 const __m128d u = _mm_sub_pd(_mm_mul_pd(repeat(s), _mm_set1_pd(width)), _mm_set1_pd(0.5)),
177 v = _mm_sub_pd(_mm_mul_pd(repeat(t), _mm_set1_pd(height)), _mm_set1_pd(0.5));
178 auto floor_int = [](__m128d q) {
179 const __m128i truncated = _mm_cvttpd_epi32(q);
180 const __m128i below = _mm_castpd_si128(_mm_cmplt_pd(q, _mm_cvtepi32_pd(truncated)));
181 return _mm_sub_epi32(truncated, _mm_and_si128(
182 _mm_shuffle_epi32(below, _MM_SHUFFLE(3, 1, 2, 0)), _mm_set1_epi32(1)));
183 };
184 const __m128i x = floor_int(u), y = floor_int(v);
185 return RealImageTextureCoordinates2{x, y, _mm_cvtpd_ps(_mm_sub_pd(u, _mm_cvtepi32_pd(x))),
186 _mm_cvtpd_ps(_mm_sub_pd(v, _mm_cvtepi32_pd(y)))};
187}

189static REALIMAGE_INLINE __m128i realimage_texture4(__m128d s01, __m128d t01,
190 __m128d s23, __m128d t23, const uint8_t* texture,
191 uint32_t base, uint32_t width, uint32_t height, unsigned row_shift)
192{
193 const auto lo = realimage_texture_coordinates2(s01, t01, width, height), hi = realimage_texture_coordinates2(s23, t23, width, height);
194 const __m128i x = _mm_unpacklo_epi64(lo.x, hi.x), y = _mm_unpacklo_epi64(lo.y, hi.y),
195 xmask = _mm_set1_epi32(width - 1), ymask = _mm_set1_epi32(height - 1),
196 x0 = _mm_slli_epi32(_mm_and_si128(x, xmask), 1),
197 y0 = _mm_sll_epi32(_mm_and_si128(y, ymask), _mm_cvtsi32_si128(row_shift)),
198 y1 = _mm_sll_epi32(_mm_and_si128(_mm_add_epi32(y, _mm_set1_epi32(1)), ymask), _mm_cvtsi32_si128(row_shift));
199 const __m128 fx = _mm_movelh_ps(lo.fx, hi.fx), fy = _mm_movelh_ps(lo.fy, hi.fy);
200 __m128i p00, p10, p01, p11;
201 if (!_mm_movemask_epi8(_mm_cmpeq_epi32(x0, _mm_set1_epi32((width - 1) * 2))))
202 {
203 auto pair = [&](__m128i yy) {
204 const __m128i at = _mm_add_epi32(_mm_set1_epi32(base), _mm_add_epi32(x0, yy));
205 uint32_t a, b, c, d;
206 std::memcpy(&a, texture + unsigned(_mm_cvtsi128_si32(at)), 4);
207 std::memcpy(&b, texture + unsigned(_mm_cvtsi128_si32(_mm_srli_si128(at, 4))), 4);
208 std::memcpy(&c, texture + unsigned(_mm_cvtsi128_si32(_mm_srli_si128(at, 8))), 4);
209 std::memcpy(&d, texture + unsigned(_mm_cvtsi128_si32(_mm_srli_si128(at, 12))), 4);
210 return _mm_set_epi32(d, c, b, a);
211 };
212 const __m128i top = pair(y0), bottom = pair(y1), mask = _mm_set1_epi32(65535);
213 p00 = _mm_and_si128(top, mask);
214 p10 = _mm_srli_epi32(top, 16);
215 p01 = _mm_and_si128(bottom, mask);
216 p11 = _mm_srli_epi32(bottom, 16);
217 }
218 else
219 {
220 const __m128i x1 = _mm_slli_epi32(_mm_and_si128(_mm_add_epi32(x, _mm_set1_epi32(1)), xmask), 1);
221 auto texel = [&](__m128i xx, __m128i yy) {
222 const __m128i at = _mm_add_epi32(_mm_set1_epi32(base), _mm_add_epi32(xx, yy));
223 uint16_t a, b, c, d;
224 std::memcpy(&a, texture + unsigned(_mm_cvtsi128_si32(at)), 2);
225 std::memcpy(&b, texture + unsigned(_mm_cvtsi128_si32(_mm_srli_si128(at, 4))), 2);
226 std::memcpy(&c, texture + unsigned(_mm_cvtsi128_si32(_mm_srli_si128(at, 8))), 2);
227 std::memcpy(&d, texture + unsigned(_mm_cvtsi128_si32(_mm_srli_si128(at, 12))), 2);
228 return _mm_set_epi32(d, c, b, a);
229 };
230 p00 = texel(x0, y0);
231 p10 = texel(x1, y0);
232 p01 = texel(x0, y1);
233 p11 = texel(x1, y1);
234 }
235 const __m128i full = _mm_and_si128(_mm_and_si128(p00, p10), _mm_and_si128(p01, p11));
236 // The upward green scale keeps maximum texels at 255 within the guarded error bound.
237 __m128 ambiguous = _mm_setzero_ps();
238 auto channel = [&](unsigned shift, unsigned mask) {
239 const __m128i shifts = _mm_cvtsi32_si128(shift), masks = _mm_set1_epi32(mask);
240 auto expand = [&](__m128i value) {
241 return _mm_cvtepi32_ps(_mm_and_si128(_mm_srl_epi32(value, shifts), masks));
242 };
243 const __m128 a = expand(p00), b = expand(p10), c = expand(p01), d = expand(p11),
244 top = _mm_add_ps(a, _mm_mul_ps(fx, _mm_sub_ps(b, a))),
245 bottom = _mm_add_ps(c, _mm_mul_ps(fx, _mm_sub_ps(d, c))),
246 value = _mm_mul_ps(_mm_add_ps(top, _mm_mul_ps(fy, _mm_sub_ps(bottom, top))), _mm_set1_ps(mask == 63 ? 0x1.030c32p+2f : 255.0f / mask));
247 const __m128i maximum = _mm_cmpeq_epi32(_mm_and_si128(_mm_srl_epi32(full, shifts), masks), masks),
248 integer = _mm_cvttps_epi32(value);
249 const __m128 fraction = _mm_sub_ps(value, _mm_cvtepi32_ps(integer)),
250 near_boundary = _mm_or_ps(_mm_and_ps(_mm_cmpge_ps(value, _mm_set1_ps(1)),
251 _mm_cmplt_ps(fraction, _mm_set1_ps(1.0f / 1024))),
252 _mm_cmpgt_ps(fraction, _mm_set1_ps(1 - 1.0f / 1024)));
253 ambiguous = _mm_or_ps(ambiguous, _mm_andnot_ps(_mm_castsi128_ps(maximum), near_boundary));
254 return integer;
255 };
256 __m128i rgb = _mm_or_si128(_mm_slli_epi32(channel(11, 31), 16),
257 _mm_or_si128(_mm_slli_epi32(channel(5, 63), 8), channel(0, 31)));
258 const unsigned fallback = unsigned(_mm_movemask_ps(ambiguous));
259 if (fallback & 3)
260 rgb = _mm_unpacklo_epi64(realimage_texture2_exact(s01, t01, texture, base, width, height, row_shift),
261 _mm_srli_si128(rgb, 8));
262 if (fallback & 12)
263 rgb = _mm_unpacklo_epi64(rgb, realimage_texture2_exact(s23, t23, texture, base, width, height, row_shift));
264 return rgb;
265}

268static REALIMAGE_INLINE __m128i realimage_texture4(__m256d s, __m256d t, const uint8_t* texture,
269 uint32_t base, uint32_t width, uint32_t height, unsigned row_shift)
270{
271 auto repeat = [](__m256d q) {
272 const __m256d magnitude = _mm256_andnot_pd(_mm256_set1_pd(-0.0), q);
273 if (_mm256_movemask_pd(_mm256_cmp_pd(magnitude, _mm256_set1_pd(1.0), _CMP_LT_OQ)) == 15)
274 return q;
275 if (_mm256_movemask_pd(_mm256_cmp_pd(magnitude, _mm256_set1_pd(2147483648.0), _CMP_LT_OQ)) == 15)
276 return _mm256_sub_pd(q, _mm256_cvtepi32_pd(_mm256_cvttpd_epi32(q)));
277 double values[4];
278 _mm256_storeu_pd(values, q);
279 return _mm256_set_pd(realimage_repeat_fraction(values[3]), realimage_repeat_fraction(values[2]),
280 realimage_repeat_fraction(values[1]), realimage_repeat_fraction(values[0]));
281 };
282 const __m256d u = _mm256_sub_pd(_mm256_mul_pd(repeat(s), _mm256_set1_pd(width)), _mm256_set1_pd(0.5)),
283 v = _mm256_sub_pd(_mm256_mul_pd(repeat(t), _mm256_set1_pd(height)), _mm256_set1_pd(0.5));
284 const __m256d floor_u = _mm256_floor_pd(u), floor_v = _mm256_floor_pd(v);
285 const __m128i x = _mm256_cvttpd_epi32(floor_u), y = _mm256_cvttpd_epi32(floor_v);
286 const __m256d fx = _mm256_sub_pd(u, floor_u), fy = _mm256_sub_pd(v, floor_v);
287 const __m128i xmask = _mm_set1_epi32(width - 1), ymask = _mm_set1_epi32(height - 1);
288 const __m128i x0 = _mm_slli_epi32(_mm_and_si128(x, xmask), 1),
289 y0 = _mm_sll_epi32(_mm_and_si128(y, ymask), _mm_cvtsi32_si128(row_shift)),
290 y1 = _mm_sll_epi32(_mm_and_si128(_mm_add_epi32(y, _mm_set1_epi32(1)), ymask), _mm_cvtsi32_si128(row_shift));
291 __m128i p00, p10, p01, p11;
292 if (!_mm_movemask_epi8(_mm_cmpeq_epi32(x0, _mm_set1_epi32((width - 1) * 2))))
293 {
294 auto pair = [&](__m128i yy) {
295 const __m128i at = _mm_add_epi32(_mm_set1_epi32(base), _mm_add_epi32(x0, yy));
296 return _mm_i32gather_epi32(reinterpret_cast<const int*>(texture), at, 1);
297 };
298 const __m128i top = pair(y0), bottom = pair(y1), mask = _mm_set1_epi32(65535);
299 p00 = _mm_and_si128(top, mask);
300 p10 = _mm_srli_epi32(top, 16);
301 p01 = _mm_and_si128(bottom, mask);
302 p11 = _mm_srli_epi32(bottom, 16);
303 }
304 else
305 {
306 const __m128i x1 = _mm_slli_epi32(_mm_and_si128(_mm_add_epi32(x, _mm_set1_epi32(1)), xmask), 1);
307 auto texel = [&](__m128i xx, __m128i yy) {
308 const __m128i at = _mm_add_epi32(_mm_set1_epi32(base), _mm_add_epi32(xx, yy));
309 const __m128i packed = _mm_i32gather_epi32(reinterpret_cast<const int*>(texture), _mm_and_si128(at, _mm_set1_epi32(-4)), 1);
310 return _mm_and_si128(_mm_srlv_epi32(packed, _mm_slli_epi32(_mm_and_si128(at, _mm_set1_epi32(2)), 3)), _mm_set1_epi32(65535));
311 };
312 p00 = texel(x0, y0);
313 p10 = texel(x1, y0);
314 p01 = texel(x0, y1);
315 p11 = texel(x1, y1);
316 }
317 auto channel = [&](unsigned shift, uint32_t mask) {
318 const __m128i shifts = _mm_cvtsi32_si128(shift), masks = _mm_set1_epi32(mask);
319 auto expand = [&](const __m128i p) {
320 return _mm256_cvtepi32_pd(_mm_and_si128(_mm_srl_epi32(p, shifts), masks));
321 };
322 const __m256d a = expand(p00), b = expand(p10), c = expand(p01), d = expand(p11);
323 const __m256d top = _mm256_add_pd(a, _mm256_mul_pd(fx, _mm256_sub_pd(b, a))),
324 bottom = _mm256_add_pd(c, _mm256_mul_pd(fx, _mm256_sub_pd(d, c)));
325 const __m256d color = _mm256_mul_pd(_mm256_add_pd(top,
326 _mm256_mul_pd(fy, _mm256_sub_pd(bottom, top))), _mm256_set1_pd(255));
327 return _mm256_cvttpd_epi32(color);
328 };
329 const __m128i red = channel(11, 31), green = channel(5, 63), blue = channel(0, 31);
330 const __m256i numerators = _mm256_inserti128_si256(_mm256_castsi128_si256(_mm_packs_epi32(red, green)),
331 _mm_packs_epi32(blue, _mm_setzero_si128()), 1);
332 const __m256i colors = _mm256_srli_epi16(_mm256_mulhi_epu16(numerators,
333 _mm256_set_epi16(0,0,0,0,-31710,-31710,-31710,-31710,16645,16645,16645,16645,-31710,-31710,-31710,-31710)), 4);
334 const __m128i rg = _mm256_castsi256_si128(colors), b = _mm256_extracti128_si256(colors, 1);
335 return _mm_or_si128(_mm_slli_epi32(_mm_unpacklo_epi16(rg, _mm_setzero_si128()), 16),
336 _mm_or_si128(_mm_slli_epi32(_mm_unpackhi_epi16(rg, _mm_setzero_si128()), 8), _mm_unpacklo_epi16(b, _mm_setzero_si128())));
337}

351static REALIMAGE_INLINE RealImageTextureCoordinates4 realimage_texture_coordinates4(

356 if (_mm256_movemask_pd(_mm256_cmp_pd(magnitude, _mm256_set1_pd(1.0), _CMP_LT_OQ)) == 15)
357 return q;
358 if (_mm256_movemask_pd(_mm256_cmp_pd(magnitude, _mm256_set1_pd(2147483648.0), _CMP_LT_OQ)) == 15)
359 return _mm256_sub_pd(q, _mm256_cvtepi32_pd(_mm256_cvttpd_epi32(q)));
360 double values[4];
361 _mm256_storeu_pd(values, q);
362 return _mm256_set_pd(realimage_repeat_fraction(values[3]), realimage_repeat_fraction(values[2]),
363 realimage_repeat_fraction(values[1]), realimage_repeat_fraction(values[0]));
364 };
365 const __m256d u = _mm256_sub_pd(_mm256_mul_pd(repeat(s), _mm256_set1_pd(width)), _mm256_set1_pd(0.5)),
366 v = _mm256_sub_pd(_mm256_mul_pd(repeat(t), _mm256_set1_pd(height)), _mm256_set1_pd(0.5)),
367 floor_u = _mm256_floor_pd(u), floor_v = _mm256_floor_pd(v);
368 return RealImageTextureCoordinates4{_mm256_cvttpd_epi32(floor_u), _mm256_cvttpd_epi32(floor_v),
369 _mm256_cvtpd_ps(_mm256_sub_pd(u, floor_u)), _mm256_cvtpd_ps(_mm256_sub_pd(v, floor_v))};
370}
371
372static REALIMAGE_INLINE __m256i realimage_texture8(__m256d s0, __m256d t0,
373 __m256d s1, __m256d t1, const uint8_t* texture,
374 uint32_t base, uint32_t width, uint32_t height, unsigned row_shift)
375{
376 const auto lo = realimage_texture_coordinates4(s0, t0, width, height), hi = realimage_texture_coordinates4(s1, t1, width, height);
377 const __m256i x = _mm256_inserti128_si256(_mm256_castsi128_si256(lo.x), hi.x, 1),
378 y = _mm256_inserti128_si256(_mm256_castsi128_si256(lo.y), hi.y, 1),
379 xmask = _mm256_set1_epi32(width - 1), ymask = _mm256_set1_epi32(height - 1),
380 x0 = _mm256_slli_epi32(_mm256_and_si256(x, xmask), 1),
381 y0 = _mm256_sll_epi32(_mm256_and_si256(y, ymask), _mm_cvtsi32_si128(row_shift)),
382 y1 = _mm256_sll_epi32(_mm256_and_si256(_mm256_add_epi32(y, _mm256_set1_epi32(1)), ymask), _mm_cvtsi32_si128(row_shift));
383 const __m256 fx = _mm256_insertf128_ps(_mm256_castps128_ps256(lo.fx), hi.fx, 1),
384 fy = _mm256_insertf128_ps(_mm256_castps128_ps256(lo.fy), hi.fy, 1);
385 __m256i p00, p10, p01, p11;
386 if (!_mm256_movemask_epi8(_mm256_cmpeq_epi32(x0, _mm256_set1_epi32((width - 1) * 2))))
387 {
388 auto pair = [&](__m256i yy) {
389 const __m256i at = _mm256_add_epi32(_mm256_set1_epi32(base), _mm256_add_epi32(x0, yy));
390 return _mm256_i32gather_epi32(reinterpret_cast<const int*>(texture), at, 1);
391 };
392 const __m256i top = pair(y0), bottom = pair(y1), mask = _mm256_set1_epi32(65535);
393 p00 = _mm256_and_si256(top, mask);
394 p10 = _mm256_srli_epi32(top, 16);
395 p01 = _mm256_and_si256(bottom, mask);
396 p11 = _mm256_srli_epi32(bottom, 16);
397 }
398 else
399 {
400 const __m256i x1 = _mm256_slli_epi32(_mm256_and_si256(_mm256_add_epi32(x, _mm256_set1_epi32(1)), xmask), 1);
401 auto texel = [&](__m256i xx, __m256i yy) {
402 const __m256i at = _mm256_add_epi32(_mm256_set1_epi32(base), _mm256_add_epi32(xx, yy));
403 const __m256i packed = _mm256_i32gather_epi32(reinterpret_cast<const int*>(texture), _mm256_and_si256(at, _mm256_set1_epi32(-4)), 1);
404 return _mm256_and_si256(_mm256_srlv_epi32(packed,
405 _mm256_slli_epi32(_mm256_and_si256(at, _mm256_set1_epi32(2)), 3)), _mm256_set1_epi32(65535));
406 };
407 p00 = texel(x0, y0);
408 p10 = texel(x1, y0);
409 p01 = texel(x0, y1);
410 p11 = texel(x1, y1);
411 }
412 const __m256i full = _mm256_and_si256(_mm256_and_si256(p00, p10), _mm256_and_si256(p01, p11));
413 // Recompute near RGB thresholds; float error stays below 1/4096.
414 __m256 ambiguous = _mm256_setzero_ps();
415 auto channel = [&](unsigned shift, unsigned mask) {
416 const __m128i shifts = _mm_cvtsi32_si128(shift);
417 const __m256i masks = _mm256_set1_epi32(mask);
418 auto expand = [&](__m256i value) {
419 return _mm256_cvtepi32_ps(_mm256_and_si256(_mm256_srl_epi32(value, shifts), masks));
420 };
421 const __m256 a = expand(p00), b = expand(p10), c = expand(p01), d = expand(p11),
422 top = _mm256_add_ps(a, _mm256_mul_ps(fx, _mm256_sub_ps(b, a))),
423 bottom = _mm256_add_ps(c, _mm256_mul_ps(fx, _mm256_sub_ps(d, c))),
424 value = _mm256_mul_ps(_mm256_add_ps(top, _mm256_mul_ps(fy, _mm256_sub_ps(bottom, top))), _mm256_set1_ps(255.0f / mask));
425 const __m256i maximum = _mm256_cmpeq_epi32(_mm256_and_si256(_mm256_srl_epi32(full, shifts), masks), masks),
426 integer = _mm256_or_si256(_mm256_and_si256(maximum, _mm256_set1_epi32(255)),
427 _mm256_andnot_si256(maximum, _mm256_cvttps_epi32(value)));
428 const __m256 fraction = _mm256_sub_ps(value, _mm256_cvtepi32_ps(integer)),
429 near_boundary = _mm256_or_ps(_mm256_and_ps(_mm256_cmp_ps(value, _mm256_set1_ps(1), _CMP_GE_OQ),
430 _mm256_cmp_ps(fraction, _mm256_set1_ps(1.0f / 1024), _CMP_LT_OQ)),
431 _mm256_cmp_ps(fraction, _mm256_set1_ps(1 - 1.0f / 1024), _CMP_GT_OQ));
432 ambiguous = _mm256_or_ps(ambiguous, _mm256_andnot_ps(_mm256_castsi256_ps(maximum), near_boundary));
433 return integer;
434 };
435 const __m256i red = channel(11, 31), green = channel(5, 63), blue = channel(0, 31);
436 __m256i rgb = _mm256_or_si256(_mm256_slli_epi32(red, 16),
437 _mm256_or_si256(_mm256_slli_epi32(green, 8), blue));
438 const unsigned fallback = unsigned(_mm256_movemask_ps(ambiguous));
439 if (fallback & 15)
440 rgb = _mm256_inserti128_si256(rgb, realimage_texture4_exact(s0, t0, texture, base, width, height, row_shift), 0);
441 if (fallback & 240)
442 rgb = _mm256_inserti128_si256(rgb, realimage_texture4_exact(s1, t1, texture, base, width, height, row_shift), 1);
443 return rgb;
444}
