449
450static bool valid_width(int bits)
451{
452 return bits == 8 || bits == 16 || bits == 32;
453}
454
455static uint32_t width_mask(int bits)
456{
457 return bits == 32 ? 0xffffffffu : (1u << bits) - 1u;
458}
459
460// Bulk context templates write zero to these otherwise undecoded slots.
461static bool zero_context_register(uint32_t a)
462{
463 return a == 0x008005cc || a == 0x008005d4 || a == 0x008005dc;
464}
465
466static bool integer_vertex_color_register(uint32_t a)
467{
468 return !(a & 3) && a >= CRealImage2100::IntegerVertexColorBase &&
469 a < CRealImage2100::IntegerVertexColorBase + 16;
470}
471
472static bool integer_vertex_register(uint32_t a)
473{
474 const uint32_t offset = a - CRealImage2100::IntegerVertexColorBase;
475 return integer_vertex_color_register(a) || (!(a & 3) && offset < 3 * CRealImage2100::VertexStride &&
476 (offset % CRealImage2100::VertexStride) >= 0x10 &&
477 (offset % CRealImage2100::VertexStride) < 0x20);
478}
479
480static bool flat_vertex_register(uint32_t a)
481{
482 return a >= CRealImage2100::FlatVertexBase &&
483 a < CRealImage2100::FlatVertexBase + 3 * CRealImage2100::VertexStride &&
484 (a - CRealImage2100::FlatVertexBase) % CRealImage2100::VertexStride < 0x34;
485}
486
487static bool vertex_register(uint32_t a)
488{
489 return flat_vertex_register(a) ||
490 (a >= CRealImage2100::VertexTextureBase &&
491 a < CRealImage2100::VertexTextureBase + 3 * CRealImage2100::VertexStride &&
492 (a - CRealImage2100::VertexTextureBase) % CRealImage2100::VertexStride < 0x34);
493}
494
495// Register dispatch
496
497void CRealImage2100::dac_port_map(address_map& map)
498{
499 map.unmap_value_high();
500 map(0x10, 0x10)
501 .lrw8(
502 NAME([this](offs_t) {
503 return u8(m_dac_index);
504 }),
505 NAME([this](offs_t, u8 v) {
506 m_dac_index = uint16_t((m_dac_index & 0xff00) | v);
507 m_dac_component = 0;
508 }));
509 map(0x14, 0x14)
510 .lrw8(
511 NAME([this](offs_t) {
512 return u8(m_dac_index >> 8);
513 }),
514 NAME([this](offs_t, u8 v) {
515 m_dac_index =
516 uint16_t((m_dac_index & 255) | (uint16_t(v) << 8));
517 m_dac_component = 0;
518 }));
519 // RGB640 byte registers and the streamed tables used by the NT miniport.
520 map(0x18, 0x18)
521 .lrw8(
522 NAME([this](offs_t) {
523 return dac_data_read();
524 }),
525 NAME([this](offs_t, u8 v) {
526 dac_data_write(v);
527 }));
528}
529
530// RGB indices select triples; WAT and cursor RAM are byte addressed.
531uint32_t CRealImage2100::dac_data_offset() const
532{
533 if (m_dac_index >= 0x4300 && m_dac_index < 0x4400)
534 return 0x4300 + 3u * (m_dac_index - 0x4300) + m_dac_component;
535 if (m_dac_index >= 0x4800 && m_dac_index < 0x4808)
536 return 0x4800 + 3u * (m_dac_index - 0x4800) + m_dac_component;
537 return m_dac_index;
538}
539
540void CRealImage2100::advance_dac_data()
541{
542 if ((m_dac_index >= 0x4300 && m_dac_index < 0x4400) ||
543 (m_dac_index >= 0x4800 && m_dac_index < 0x4808))
544 {
545 if (++m_dac_component == 3)
546 {
547 m_dac_component = 0;
548 ++m_dac_index;
549 }
550 }
551 else if ((m_dac_index >= 0x0100 && m_dac_index < 0x0140) ||
552 (m_dac_index >= 0x0200 && m_dac_index < 0x0240) ||
553 (m_dac_index >= 0x1000 && m_dac_index < 0x1400))
554 ++m_dac_index;
555}
556
557uint8_t CRealImage2100::dac_data_read()
558{
559 const uint8_t value = m_dac_regs[dac_data_offset()];
560 advance_dac_data();
561 return value;
562}
563
564void CRealImage2100::dac_data_write(uint8_t value)
565{
566 const uint32_t offset = dac_data_offset();
567 if (offset == 0xfb)
568 m_dac_regs[offset] = (m_dac_regs[offset] & 6) | (value & 1);
569 else if (offset < 0xfc || offset > 0xff)
570 m_dac_regs[offset] = value;
571 advance_dac_data();
572}
573
574uint32_t CRealImage2100::misr_step(uint32_t signature, uint32_t pixel)
575{
576 return ((signature << 1) ^ pixel ^
577 ((signature & 0x20000000u) ? 0x00800007u : 0)) & 0x3fffffffu;
578}
579
580uint32_t CRealImage2100::dac_rgb30(uint32_t pixel)
581{
582 const uint32_t r = (pixel >> 16) & 255, g = (pixel >> 8) & 255, b = pixel & 255;
583 return (((r << 2) | (r >> 6)) << 20) |
584 (((g << 2) | (g >> 6)) << 10) | (b << 2) | (b >> 6);
585}
586
587bool CRealImage2100::capture_misr(uint32_t& signature)
588{
589 // The supported RGB640 input serializes four RGB888 pixels per VRAM load.
590 const uint8_t serializer[] = { 0x30, 0x31, 0x32, 0x33, 0x10, 0x11, 1, 0 };
591 if (!std::equal(std::begin(serializer), std::end(serializer), m_dac_regs.begin() + 2))
592 return false;
593 const unsigned wid_control = m_dac_regs[0x0a] & 7, cursor_control = m_dac_regs[0x4b] & ~0x10u;
594 if ((m_dac_regs[0x0a] & 0x18) ||
595 (wid_control != 0 && wid_control != 4 && wid_control != 5 && wid_control != 6) ||
596 (cursor_control != 0 && cursor_control != 8 && cursor_control != 0x0a &&
597 cursor_control != 0x0b) || m_dac_regs[0x57])
598 return false;
599 Frame frame = dac_frame(Frame{}, nullptr, true);
600 if (frame.argb.empty())
601 return false;
602 const unsigned byte_mask = m_dac_regs[0xf0] | (unsigned(m_dac_regs[0xf1]) << 8);
603 for (uint32_t y = 0; y < frame.height; ++y)
604 for (uint32_t x = 0; x < frame.width; ++x)
605 {
606 const unsigned phase = x & 3;
607 const unsigned wid = wid_control && (m_dac_regs[0xf2] & (1u << phase)) ?
608 (m_auxiliary[size_t(y) * m_color_width + x] >> 12) & 15 : 0;
609 const unsigned fb = 0x100 + 4 * wid, overlay = 0x200 + 4 * wid;
610 if (m_dac_regs[fb] != 9 || m_dac_regs[fb + 2] || m_dac_regs[fb + 3] ||
611 m_dac_regs[overlay] != 4 || m_dac_regs[overlay + 1] ||
612 m_dac_regs[overlay + 2] || m_dac_regs[overlay + 3] != 0x44)
613 return false;
614 uint32_t& pixel = frame.argb[size_t(y) * frame.width + x];
615 const unsigned enables = (byte_mask >> (4 * phase)) & 7;
616 pixel &= ((enables & 1) ? 0x0000ffu : 0) |
617 ((enables & 2) ? 0x00ff00u : 0) | ((enables & 4) ? 0xff0000u : 0);
618 pixel = dac_rgb30(pixel);
619 }
620 composite_cursor(frame, true);
621 // Accumulate active pixels after cursor composition and before analog blanking.
622 uint32_t accumulator = 0x3fffffffu;
623 for (uint32_t pixel : frame.argb)
624 accumulator = misr_step(accumulator, pixel);
625 signature = (~accumulator) & 0x3fffffffu;
626 return true;
627}
628
629void CRealImage2100::advance_frame()
630{
631 ++m_frame_counter;
632 uint8_t& control = m_dac_regs[0xfb];
633 // RGB640 requires a disabled frame before another signature capture.
634 if (!(control & 1))
635 {
636 control = 0;
637 return;
638 }
639 if (!(control & 6))
640 {
641 control = 5;
642 std::fill(m_dac_regs.begin() + 0xfc, m_dac_regs.begin() + 0x100, uint8_t(0));
643 }
644 else if ((control & 6) == 4)
645 {
646 uint32_t signature;
647 if (!capture_misr(signature))
648 {
649 unimplemented_once("RGB640 MISR input profile", 0x838018, control, true);
650 return;
651 }
652 for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
653 m_dac_regs[0xfc + i] = uint8_t(signature >> (8 * i));
654 control = 3;
655 }
656}
657
658// Readback latches, display selection and unit reset.
659uint32_t* CRealImage2100::native_register(uint32_t a)
660{
661 if (a >= DMABase && a < DMABase + DMARegisterCount * 4)
662 return &m_dma_regs[(a - DMABase) / 4];
663 switch (a)
664 {
665 case UnitReset:
666 return &m_unit_reset;
667 case InterruptEnable:
668 return &m_interrupt_enable;
669 case VGAControl:
670 return &m_vga_control;
671 case DisplayControl:
672 return &m_display_control;
673 default:
674 return nullptr;
675 }
676}
677
678// Drawing is synchronous. Synthetic retrace sits inside vertical blank.
679uint32_t CRealImage2100::status_read()
680{
681 const uint32_t phase = m_status_phase;
682 m_status_phase = (phase + 1) % StatusFrameReads;
683 if (m_status_phase == 0)
684 advance_frame();
685 uint32_t v = 0;
686 if (phase >= StatusFrameReads - 8)
687 v |= StatusVBlank;
688 if (phase >= StatusFrameReads - 6 && phase < StatusFrameReads - 2)
689 v |= StatusVRetrace;
690 return v;
691}
692
693uint32_t CRealImage2100::ReadMem(uint32_t a, int bits)
694{
695 if (!valid_width(bits) || (a & (unsigned(bits) / 8 - 1)))
696 {
697 report(
698 "ACCESS_WIDTH", a, uint32_t(bits),
699 "Invalid native width or alignment");
700 return 0xffffffffu;
701 }
702 if (flat_vertex_register(a & ~3u))
703 a -= 0x100;
704 uint32_t pixel = 0;
705 if (framebuffer_access(a, bits, pixel, false))
706 return pixel;
707 if (a >= 0x838000 && a < 0x838020 &&
708 m_dac_ports.has_handler(a - 0x838000))
709 return m_dac_ports.read_byte(a - 0x838000);
710 if (const uint32_t* reg = native_register(a & ~3u))
711 return (*reg >> ((a & 3) * 8)) & width_mask(bits);
712 if ((a & ~3u) == Status)
713 return (status_read() >> ((a & 3) * 8)) & width_mask(bits);
714 if ((a & ~3u) == BoardStatus)
715 {
716 const uint32_t v = m_frame_counter | (uint32_t(m_board_straps) << 16) |
717 (uint32_t(m_board_control) << 24);
718 return (v >> ((a & 3) * 8)) & width_mask(bits);
719 }
720 if ((a & ~3u) == BoardIO)
721 {
722 const uint32_t v = m_board_io | (uint32_t(BoardIDPCGA3) << 24);
723 return (v >> ((a & 3) * 8)) & width_mask(bits);
724 }
725 if (m_readback.width && a >= HostData && a < HostData + HostReadSize)
726 {
727 if (bits == 32)
728 return host_read();
729 unimplemented_once("REALimage host readback", a, 0, false);
730 return 0;
731 }
732 const auto it = m_shadow.find(a & ~3u);
733 const uint32_t value = it == m_shadow.end() ? 0 : it->second;
734 // Reads return the stored value; readback is modeled, not measured.
735 if (!native_storage_register(a & ~3u))
736 unimplemented_once("REALimage register", a, value, false);
737 return (value >> ((a & 3) * 8)) & width_mask(bits);
738}
739
740void CRealImage2100::WriteMem(uint32_t a, int bits, uint32_t v)
741{
742 if (!valid_width(bits) || (a & (unsigned(bits) / 8 - 1)))
743 {
744 report("ACCESS_WIDTH", a, v, "Invalid native width or alignment");
745 return;
746 }
747 const uint32_t original_address = a;
748 if ((flat_vertex_register(a & ~3u) || integer_vertex_register(a & ~3u)) && bits != 32)
749 {
750 unimplemented_once("REALimage vertex width (command rejected)", a, v, true);
751 return;
752 }
753 // Flat and smooth floating-point ports address the same vertex slots.
754 if (flat_vertex_register(a & ~3u))
755 a -= 0x100;
756 if (framebuffer_access(a, bits, v, true))
757 return;
758 if (a >= 0x838000 && a < 0x838020 &&
759 m_dac_ports.has_handler(a - 0x838000))
760 {
761 m_dac_ports.write_byte(a - 0x838000, u8(v));
762 return;
763 }
764 const uint32_t key = a & ~3u, shift = (a & 3) * 8,
765 lanes = width_mask(bits) << shift;
766 if (uint32_t* reg = native_register(key))
767 {
768 *reg = (*reg & ~lanes) | ((v << shift) & lanes);
769 // Unit resets cancel an in-flight host transfer, not color storage.
770 if (key == UnitReset && !(*reg & (1u << 26)))
771 {
772 m_pending = {};
773 m_readback = {};
774 }
775 if (key == DMAControl)
776 {
777 if ((v << shift) & lanes & 0x200u)
778 m_dma_irq_pending = false;
779 update_irq();
780 if (*reg & ~0x200u)
781 unimplemented_once("REALimage DMA control profile", a, v, true);
782 }
783 if (key == DMAInterruptEnable)
784 {
785 update_irq();
786 if (*reg != 0 && *reg != 1 && *reg != 7)
787 unimplemented_once("REALimage DMA interrupt profile", a, v, true);
788 }
789 if (key == DMAReset && (*reg & 1))
790 {
791 m_dma_regs[(DMACommand - DMABase) / 4] = 0;
792 m_dma_irq_pending = false;
793 update_irq();
794 }
795 if (key == DMACommand && (lanes & 0xc0000000) &&
796 (*reg & 0xc0000000))
797 {
798 if (m_dma_regs[(DMAReset - DMABase) / 4] & 1)
799 *reg = 0;
800 else if (bits == 32)
801 dma_command(*reg);
802 else
803 unimplemented(
804 "REALimage DMA transfer (rejected; completion not written)",
805 key, *reg, true);
806 }
807 return;
808 }
809 if (key == Status)
810 {
811 // OpenVMS writes the upper status mask after idle; timing reads remain live.
812 const uint32_t written = (v << shift) & lanes;
813 if (written && written != (StatusVBlank & lanes) &&
814 written != (0xff800000u & lanes))
815 unimplemented_once("REALimage status register", a, v, true);
816 return;
817 }
818 // Whole-longword Alpha miniport writes leave counter and strap bytes unchanged.
819 if (key == BoardStatus)
820 {
821 if (lanes & 0xff000000u)
822 m_board_control = uint8_t(((v << shift) & lanes) >> 24);
823 return;
824 }
825 if (key == BoardIO)
826 {
827 m_board_io = (m_board_io & ~lanes & 0x00ffffffu) |
828 ((v << shift) & lanes & 0x00ffffffu);
829 if (lanes & 0xff000000u)
830 m_board_timing = uint8_t(((v << shift) & lanes) >> 24);
831 return;
832 }
833 // Configuration accesses must not consume a pending pixel upload.
834 if (a >= HostData &&
835 !(key == HostData + 0x400 && (peek(DrawControl) & 0x04000000u)) &&
836 (a < HostData + HostDataSize ||
837 (m_pending.width && !(peek(DrawControl) & 0x04000000u) &&
838 a < HostData + HostUploadSize)))
839 {
840 if (bits == 32)
841 host_data(v);
842 else
843 unimplemented_once("REALimage host-data width", a, v, true);
844 return;
845 }
846 auto it = m_shadow.find(key);
847 if (it == m_shadow.end())
848 {
849 if (m_shadow.size() >= MaxShadowRegisters)
850 {
851 unimplemented_once("REALimage register", a, v, true);
852 if (!m_shadow_full_warned)
853 {
854 m_shadow_full_warned = true;
855 report(
856 "SHADOW_LIMIT", a, v,
857 "Native register storage full; further writes ignored");
858 }
859 return;
860 }
861 it = m_shadow.emplace(key, 0).first;
862 }
863 const uint32_t old_value = it->second;
864 it->second = (old_value & ~lanes) | ((v << shift) & lanes);
865 if ((key == DrawControl && ((old_value ^ it->second) & 0x00000f01u)) ||
866 (key == MemoryControl && old_value != it->second))
867 m_clear_cache = {};
868 if (plane_write(key, lanes, (v << shift) & lanes))
869 return;
870 if (integer_vertex_register(key))
871 {
872 if ((key - IntegerVertexColorBase) % VertexStride == 0x1c)
873 raster_vertex_command(key, it->second);
874 }
875 else if (vertex_register(key))
876 {
877 if (bits != 32)
878 unimplemented_once("REALimage vertex width (command rejected)", a, v, true);
879 else if ((key - VertexBase) % VertexStride == 0x1c)
880 {
881 if (flat_vertex_register(original_address) && (it->second == 0x22 || it->second == 0x62))
882 raster_vertex_command(original_address, it->second);
883 else
884 triangle_command(original_address, it->second);
885 }
886 }
887 else if (key == HostCommand || key == FillCommand || key == BitmapCommand || key == BlockCommand)
888 {
889 // Only longword command launches have been established by the driver.
890 if (bits == 32)
891 {
892 if (key == BlockCommand)
893 block_command(it->second);
894 else
895 start_command(key, it->second);
896 }
897 else
898 unimplemented_once("REALimage command width (command rejected)", a, v, true);
899 }
900 else if (key == SyncCommand)
901 {
902 // Idle startup synchronization does not cancel an unfinished upload.
903 if (bits != 32 || (it->second && it->second != 0x80000000u) ||
904 m_pending.width || m_readback.width)
905 unimplemented_once("REALimage synchronization command (command rejected)", a, v, true);
906 }
907 else if (key == DisplaySelect)
908 {
909 // Format 3 uses RGB color with independent clock/capability flags.
910 if (it->second && (it->second & ~0x4100u) != 0x0600)
911 unimplemented_once("REALimage display selector", a, v, true);
912 }
913 else if (key == BoardSetup)
914 {
915 if (it->second & ~0x00820000u)
916 unimplemented_once("REALimage board setup/profile", a, v, true);
917 }
918 else if (key == InitializationPort)
919 {
920 if (it->second)
921 unimplemented_once("REALimage initialization port/profile", a, v, true);
922 }
923 else if (zero_context_register(key))
924 {
925 if (it->second)
926 unimplemented_once("REALimage context register/profile", a, v, true);
927 }
928 else if (!native_storage_register(key))
929 {
930 // Unmodeled mask aliases must not leave a stale block mask usable.
931 if ((key & ~0x1fe000u) == HostData + 0x400 &&
932 (peek(DrawControl) & (1u << 26)))
933 for (unsigned bank = 0; bank < PlaneCount; ++bank)
934 if (peek(DrawControl) & (0x1000u << bank))
935 m_planes[bank].unknown_masks |= (key >> 13) &
936 (m_color_width == MaxColorWidth ? 255u : 15u);
937 unimplemented_once("REALimage register", a, v, true);
938 }
939}
940
941// Native drawing profiles decoded from the NT drivers and traces.
942
943uint32_t CRealImage2100::peek(uint32_t a) const
944{
945 const auto it = m_shadow.find(a & ~3u);
946 return it == m_shadow.end() ? 0 : it->second;
947}
948
949int CRealImage2100::plane_register(uint32_t a)
950{
951 if ((a & ~0x001fe01cu) == 0x00e00100u && (a & 0x001fe000u))
952 return 16 + int((a & 0x1c) / 4);
953 if (a == PlanePixelMask || (a & ~0x1fe000u) == HostData + 0x400)
954 return 24;
955 // DFE7xx and FFE7xx are the two observed full-selector state forms.
956 const uint32_t state_address = a | 0x00200000u;
957 switch (state_address)
958 {
959 case PlaneStateBase + 0x00: case PlaneStateBase + 0x04:
960 case PlaneStateBase + 0x08: case PlaneStateBase + 0x0c:
961 case PlaneStateBase + 0x10: case PlaneStateBase + 0x14:
962 case PlaneStateBase + 0x18: case PlaneStateBase + 0x1c:
963 case PlaneStateBase + 0x20:
964 case PlaneStateBase + 0x24: case PlaneStateBase + 0x28:
965 case PlaneStateBase + 0x2c: case PlaneStateBase + 0x30:
966 case PlaneStateBase + 0x34: case PlaneStateBase + 0x38:
967 case PlaneStateBase + 0x3c:
968 return int((state_address - PlaneStateBase) / 4);
969 default:
970 return -1;
971 }
972}
973
974bool CRealImage2100::plane_write(uint32_t a, uint32_t lanes, uint32_t value)
975{
976 const int index = plane_register(a);
977 if (index < 0)
978 return false;
979 const uint32_t control = peek(DrawControl), banks = (control >> 12) & 15;
980 if (!(control & (1u << 26)))
981 {
982 unimplemented_once("REALimage plane access", a, value, true);
983 return true;
984 }
985 const bool clear = index >= 16 && index < 24,
986 broadcast = clear && (a & ~0x1fu) == PlaneClearColor;
987 const uint32_t available = m_color_width == MaxColorWidth ? 255u : 15u,
988 groups = a == PlanePixelMask || broadcast ? available : (a >> 13) & 255;
989 if ((index == 24 || clear) && (groups & ~available))
990 {
991 for (unsigned bank = 0; bank < PlaneCount; ++bank)
992 if (banks & (1u << bank))
993 m_planes[bank].unknown_masks |= groups & available;
994 unimplemented_once(clear ? "REALimage clear-source selector" : "REALimage plane mask",
995 a, value, true);
996 return true;
997 }
998 // Configuration writes broadcast to the selected 3D-RAM planes.
999 for (unsigned bank = 0; bank < PlaneCount; ++bank)
1000 if (banks & (1u << bank))
1001 {
1002 auto& plane = m_planes[bank];
1003 if (clear)
1004 {
1005 const unsigned word = unsigned(index - 16);
1006 for (unsigned group = 0; group < 8; ++group)
1007 if (groups & (1u << group))
1008 {
1009 if (broadcast && lanes == 0xffffffffu)
1010 {
1011 plane.clear_written[group] &= uint8_t(~(1u << word));
1012 plane.clear_colors[group][word] = 0;
1013 }
1014 else if (!broadcast || (plane.clear_written[group] & (1u << word)))
1015 {
1016 plane.clear_colors[group][word] =
1017 (plane_clear_value(bank, group, word) & ~lanes) | value;
1018 plane.clear_written[group] |= uint8_t(1u << word);
1019 }
1020 }
1021 if (!broadcast)
1022 continue;
1023 }
1024 if (index == 24 && lanes == 0xffffffffu)
1025 plane.unknown_masks &= ~groups;
1026 const unsigned end = index == 24 ? PlaneRegisterCount : index + 1;
1027 for (unsigned i = unsigned(index); i < end; ++i)
1028 {
1029 if (index == 24 && !(groups & (1u << (i - 24))))
1030 continue;
1031 plane.regs[i] = (plane.regs[i] & ~lanes) | value;
1032 plane.written |= 1u << i;
1033 }
1034 }
1035 return true;
1036}
1037
1038uint32_t CRealImage2100::plane_value(
1039 unsigned bank, unsigned index, uint32_t fallback) const
1040{
1041 const auto& plane = m_planes[bank];
1042 return plane.written & (1u << index) ? plane.regs[index] : fallback;
1043}
1044
1045uint32_t CRealImage2100::plane_clear_value(unsigned bank, unsigned group, unsigned word) const
1046{
1047 const auto& plane = m_planes[bank];
1048 return plane.clear_written[group] & (1u << word) ?
1049 plane.clear_colors[group][word] : plane_value(bank, 16 + word, 0);
1050}
1051
1052bool CRealImage2100::plane_clear_written(unsigned bank, unsigned group, unsigned word) const
1053{
1054 return (m_planes[bank].clear_written[group] & (1u << word)) ||
1055 (m_planes[bank].written & (1u << (16 + word)));
1056}
1057
1058bool CRealImage2100::plane_profile(unsigned bank, uint32_t format, uint32_t rop_high,
1059 uint32_t multiply_control) const
1060{
1061 // Callers select the supported operation; comparisons remain guarded.
1062 const uint32_t compare_mask = plane_value(bank, 10, 0);
1063 return plane_value(bank, 1, 0) == 0 && plane_value(bank, 2, 0) == 0 &&
1064 plane_value(bank, 3, 0) == 0 &&
1065 (plane_value(bank, 4, 0x03030303) & 0xf0f0f0f0) == rop_high &&
1066 plane_value(bank, 5, 0x0a000000) == 0x0a000000 &&
1067 plane_value(bank, 6, 0) == 0 && plane_value(bank, 7, 0) == 0 &&
1068 plane_value(bank, 8, 0) == multiply_control &&
1069 plane_value(bank, 9, 0) == 0 &&
1070 (compare_mask == 0 || compare_mask == 0x00ff0000) &&
1071 plane_value(bank, 11, 0x33300000) == 0x33300000 &&
1072 plane_value(bank, 12, 0x100) == 0x100 && plane_value(bank, 13, 0) == 0 &&
1073 plane_value(bank, 14, 0x100) == format &&
1074 plane_value(bank, 15, 0) == 0;
1075}
1076
1077bool CRealImage2100::native_storage_register(uint32_t a) const
1078{
1079 return plane_register(a) >= 0 || vertex_register(a) || integer_vertex_register(a) ||
1080 a == TextureBase || a == ContextLink ||
1081 a == DrawControl || a == MemoryControl || a == PixelControl ||
1082 a == Foreground || a == Background || a == HostOrigin ||
1083 a == MonoPattern0 || a == MonoPattern1 ||
1084 a == MonoPattern2 || a == MonoPattern3 ||
1085 a == HostExtent || a == FillOrigin || a == FillExtent ||
1086 a == HostCommand || a == FillCommand ||
1087 a == BitmapForeground || a == BitmapBackground ||
1088 a == BitmapPattern0 || a == BitmapPattern1 ||
1089 a == BitmapOrigin || a == BitmapExtent || a == BitmapCommand ||
1090 a == BlockSource || a == BlockDestination || a == BlockExtent ||
1091 a == BlockCommand ||
1092 a == ContextControl || a == DisplaySelect ||
1093 a == BoardSetup || a == InitializationPort ||
1094 a == BoardTiming || a == WindowMask ||
1095 a == ClipXMax || a == ClipYMax || a == ClipXMin || a == ClipYMin ||
1096 a == GlobalControl0 || a == GlobalControl1 || a == GlobalControl2 ||
1097 a == PipelineControl0 || a == PipelineControl1 ||
1098 a == PipelineControl2 || a == PipelineControl3 ||
1099 a == PipelineControl4 || a == PipelineControl5 ||
1100 zero_context_register(a) ||
1101 (a >= TimingBase && a <= TimingBase + 0x1c);
1102}
1103
1104bool CRealImage2100::native_pixel_profile() const
1105{
1106 const uint32_t memory = peek(MemoryControl);
1107 return (memory & 0x00ffffff) == 0x8000 &&
1108 (peek(PixelControl) & ~0x08000000u) ==
1109 (m_color_width == MaxColorWidth ? 0x62722060u : 0x42722060u);
1110}
1111
1112uint32_t CRealImage2100::block_width() const
1113{
1114 const uint32_t format = peek(DrawControl) & 255;
1115 return format == 2 ? 8 : format == 3 && m_color_width == MaxColorWidth ? 16 : 0;
1116}
1117
1118bool CRealImage2100::native_copy_control_profile(bool clear, bool integer) const
1119{
1120 const uint32_t width = block_width(), columns = (peek(DrawControl) >> 8) & 15,
1121 copy_columns = ((peek(MemoryControl) >> 24) & 63) + 1;
1122 // Each page column spans two copy blocks; the top two bits control timing.
1123 if (!native_pixel_profile() || !width || columns != (copy_columns + 1) / 2 ||
1124 copy_columns > (m_color_width + 10 * width - 1) / (10 * width))
1125 return false;
1126 const uint32_t global = peek(GlobalControl0), control = peek(DrawControl);
1127 const bool integer_profile = integer || (clear && ((control & ~0x0400ff01u) == 0xa1000002u ||
1128 (control & ~0x04ff0f01u) == 0xa1004002u));
1129 // Integer raster commands can retain the preceding line mode.
1130 const bool retained_line = clear && integer_profile && (global == 1 || global == 3);
1131 const bool context_clear = clear && (global == 0x180 || global == 0x190) &&
1132 peek(GlobalControl1) == 0x20800;
1133 // Other programmed pipeline modes have not been decoded.
1134 const std::pair<uint32_t, uint32_t> profile[] = {
1135 {GlobalControl0, integer_profile ? (retained_line ? global : 0u) : context_clear ? global : 1u},
1136 {GlobalControl1, integer_profile ? 0x20810u : context_clear ? 0x20800u : 0x20811u},
1137 {GlobalControl2, 0x33},
1138 {PipelineControl0, 0}, {PipelineControl1, 0},
1139 {PipelineControl2, 0x10000000}, {PipelineControl3, 0},
1140 {PipelineControl4, 0}, {PipelineControl5, 0},
1141 {0x008005cc, 0}, {0x008005d4, 0}, {0x008005dc, 0}};
1142 for (const auto& reg : profile)
1143 {
1144 const auto it = m_shadow.find(reg.first);
1145 if (it != m_shadow.end() && it->second != reg.second)
1146 return false;
1147 }
1148 return true;
1149}
1150
1151bool CRealImage2100::copy_profile() const
1152{
1153 // Only the observed RGB copy profile; bits 12..15 select banks.
1154 const uint32_t control = peek(DrawControl), banks = (control >> 12) & 15;
1155 return (control & ~0xff01u) == 0x81000002 && banks && !(banks & ~3u) &&
1156 native_copy_control_profile();
1157}
1158
1159bool CRealImage2100::block_copy_profile() const
1160{
1161 const uint32_t control = peek(DrawControl), banks = (control >> 12) & 15;
1162 if ((control & ~0xff01u) != 0xa1000002u ||
1163 (banks != 1 && banks != 2 && banks != 5 && banks != 6) ||
1164 !native_copy_control_profile(true, true))
1165 return false;
1166 const unsigned bank = banks & 2 ? 1 : 0;
1167 if (!plane_profile(bank) || m_planes[bank].unknown_masks ||
1168 ((plane_value(bank, 0, 0xffffffff) & 0xff000000u) &&
1169 (plane_value(bank, 4, 0x03030303) >> 24) != 5))
1170 return false;
1171 if (!(banks & 4))
1172 return true;
1173 if (m_planes[2].unknown_masks)
1174 return false;
1175 const uint32_t expected[] = {0, 0, 0x0fff0fff, 0x03030303, 0x0a000000,
1176 0, 0, 0, 0, 0x00ff0000, 0x33300000, 0x100, 0, 0x100, 0};
1177 for (unsigned i = 0; i < std::size(expected); ++i)
1178 if (plane_value(2, i + 1, expected[i]) != expected[i])
1179 return false;
1180 return true;
1181}
1182
1183bool CRealImage2100::block_transfer_profile(bool upload, bool native_command) const
1184{
1185 const uint32_t control = peek(DrawControl), banks = (control >> 12) & 15;
1186 if (upload && !native_command && (banks == 5 || banks == 6))
1187 return integer_rgb_profile();
1188 const bool native_transfer = native_command || (upload && (banks == 1 || banks == 2) &&
1189 (control & ~0x00ffff01u) == 0xa1000002u);
1190 // Native RGB transfers retain inactive window references.
1191 const uint32_t fields = native_transfer ? 0x00ffff01u : 0xff01u,
1192 mode = native_transfer ? 0xa1000002u : 0x21000002u;
1193 if ((control & ~fields) != mode || !banks || (banks & ~3u) ||
1194 !native_copy_control_profile(true, true))
1195 return false;
1196 for (unsigned bank = 0; bank < 2; ++bank)
1197 if (banks & (1u << bank))
1198 {
1199 if (!plane_profile(bank) || m_planes[bank].unknown_masks ||
1200 ((plane_value(bank, 0, 0xffffffff) & 0xff000000u) &&
1201 (plane_value(bank, 4, 0x03030303) >> 24) != 5))
1202 return false;
1203 }
1204 return true;
1205}
1206
1207bool CRealImage2100::bitmap_profile() const
1208{
1209 const uint32_t control = peek(DrawControl);
1210 if ((control & ~0x00ff0f01u) != 0xa1004002u ||
1211 !native_copy_control_profile(true, true) ||
1212 plane_value(2, 0, 0) != 0x10000000u || m_planes[2].unknown_masks ||
1213 ((peek(ClipXMin) | peek(ClipYMin) | peek(ClipXMax) | peek(ClipYMax)) & 0xffff000fu))
1214 return false;
1215 const uint32_t expected[] = {0, 0, 0x0fff0fff, 0x03030303, 0x0a000000,
1216 0, 0, 0, 0, 0x00ff0000, 0x33300000, 0x100, 0, 0x100, 0};
1217 for (unsigned i = 0; i < std::size(expected); ++i)
1218 if (plane_value(2, i + 1, expected[i]) != expected[i])
1219 return false;
1220 for (unsigned i = 24; i < 24 + block_width() / 2; ++i)
1221 if (plane_value(2, i, 0xffffffff) != 0xffffffff)
1222 return false;
1223 return true;
1224}
1225
1226bool CRealImage2100::auxiliary_mono_profile() const
1227{
1228 const uint32_t control = peek(DrawControl);
1229 if ((control & ~0x00ff0f01u) != 0xa5004002u ||
1230 !native_copy_control_profile(true, true) || m_planes[2].unknown_masks)
1231 return false;
1232 const uint32_t expected[] = {0, 0, 0x0fff0fff, 0x03030303, 0x0a000000,
1233 0, 0, 0, 0, 0x00ff0000, 0x33300000, 0x100, 0, 0x100, 0};
1234 for (unsigned i = 0; i < std::size(expected); ++i)
1235 if (plane_value(2, i + 1, expected[i]) != expected[i])
1236 return false;
1237 for (unsigned i = 24; i < 24 + block_width() / 2; ++i)
1238 if (plane_value(2, i, 0xffffffff) != 0xffffffff)
1239 return false;
1240 for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
1241 if (peek(MonoPattern0 + i * 4) != 0xffffffff)
1242 return false;
1243 return true;
1244}
1245
1246bool CRealImage2100::integer_rgb_profile(bool configuration) const
1247{
1248 const uint32_t control = peek(DrawControl), banks = (control >> 12) & 15;
1249 const bool auxiliary_compare = (control & ~0x00ffff01u) == 0xa1000002u &&
1250 (banks == 5 || banks == 6),
1251 direct = (control & ~0xff01u) == 0x21000002u && (banks == 1 || banks == 2),
1252 rectangle = configuration && (control & ~0x00ffff01u) == 0xa5000002u &&
1253 (banks == 1 || banks == 2);
1254 if ((!auxiliary_compare && !direct && !rectangle) || !native_copy_control_profile(true, true))
1255 return false;
1256 const unsigned bank = banks & 2 ? 1 : 0;
1257 if (!plane_profile(bank) || m_planes[bank].unknown_masks ||
1258 ((plane_value(bank, 0, 0xffffffff) & 0xff000000u) &&
1259 (plane_value(bank, 4, 0x03030303) >> 24) != 5))
1260 return false;
1261 if (!auxiliary_compare)
1262 return true;
1263 if (plane_value(2, 0, 0xffffffff) || m_planes[2].unknown_masks)
1264 return false;
1265 const uint32_t expected[] = {0, 0x8000, 0x0fff0fff, 0x03030303, 0x0a000200,
1266 0, 0, 0, 0, 0x00ff0000, 0x33300000, 0x100, 0, 0x100, 0};
1267 for (unsigned i = 0; i < std::size(expected); ++i)
1268 if (plane_value(2, i + 1, expected[i]) != expected[i])
1269 return false;
1270 return true;
1271}
1272
1273bool CRealImage2100::fast_copy_profile(bool block) const
1274{
1275 const uint32_t control = peek(DrawControl), banks = (control >> 12) & 15,
1276 fields = block ? 0x00ffff01u : 0xff01u;
1277 if ((control & ~fields) != 0x21000002 || (banks != 1 && banks != 2) ||
1278 !native_copy_control_profile(block, block))
1279 return false;
1280 const unsigned bank = banks == 2 ? 1 : 0;
1281 if ((plane_value(bank, 0, 0xffffffff) & 0xffffff) != 0xffffff ||
1282 plane_value(bank, 1, 0) != 0 || plane_value(bank, 2, 0) != 0 ||
1283 plane_value(bank, 3, 0) != 0 ||
1284 plane_value(bank, 4, 0x03030303) != 0x05050505 ||
1285 plane_value(bank, 5, 0x0a000000) != 0 || plane_value(bank, 6, 0) != 1 ||
1286 plane_value(bank, 7, 0) != 0 ||
1287 plane_value(bank, 8, 0) != 0 || plane_value(bank, 9, 0) != 0 ||
1288 (plane_value(bank, 10, 0) != 0 && (!block || plane_value(bank, 10, 0) != 0x00ff0000)) ||
1289 plane_value(bank, 11, 0x33300000) != 0x33300000 ||
1290 plane_value(bank, 12, 0x100) != 0x100 || plane_value(bank, 13, 0) != 0 ||
1291 plane_value(bank, 14, 0x100) != 0x100 || plane_value(bank, 15, 0) != 0 ||
1292 m_planes[bank].unknown_masks)
1293 return false;
1294 // Native block copies bypass retained configuration masks.
1295 if (!block)
1296 for (unsigned i = 24; i < 24 + block_width() / 2; ++i)
1297 if (plane_value(bank, i, 0xffffffff) != 0xffffffff)
1298 return false;
1299 return true;
1300}
1301
1302CRealImage2100::ColorWriteContext CRealImage2100::prepare_color_write() const
1303{
1304 ColorWriteContext context;
1305 for (unsigned bank = 0; bank < 2; ++bank)
1306 {
1307 context.masks[bank] = plane_value(bank, 0, 0xffffffff);
1308 context.rops[bank] = plane_value(bank, 4, 0x03030303);
1309 }
1310 return context;
1311}
1312
1313CRealImage2100::PixelOperation CRealImage2100::prepare_pixel(uint32_t x,
1314 uint32_t y, uint32_t value, uint32_t banks, uint32_t lanes, bool invalidate_cache) const
1315{
1316 return {prepare_color_write(), x, y, value, banks, lanes, invalidate_cache};
1317}
1318
1319void CRealImage2100::execute_pixel(const PixelOperation& operation)
1320{
1321 if (operation.invalidate_cache)
1322 for (unsigned bank = 0; bank < 2; ++bank)
1323 if (operation.banks & (1u << bank))
1324 m_clear_cache[bank] = {};
1325 color_write(operation.context, operation.x, operation.y, operation.value,
1326 operation.banks, operation.lanes);
1327}
1328
1329void CRealImage2100::color_write(const ColorWriteContext& context,
1330 uint32_t x, uint32_t y, uint32_t color, uint32_t banks, uint32_t lanes)
1331{
1332 if (x >= m_color_width || y >= m_color_height)
1333 return;
1334 const uint32_t offset = y * m_color_width + x;
1335 for (uint32_t bank = 0; bank < 2; ++bank)
1336 if (banks & (1u << bank))
1337 {
1338 uint32_t& destination = m_color[bank * m_color_pixels + offset];
1339 const uint32_t mask = context.masks[bank] & lanes & 0xffffff,
1340 rops = context.rops[bank];
1341 uint32_t result = 0;
1342 for (unsigned shift = 0; shift < 24; shift += 8)
1343 {
1344 const unsigned op = (rops >> shift) & 15;
1345 uint32_t channel = 0;
1346 if (op & 1) channel |= color & destination;
1347 if (op & 2) channel |= color & ~destination;
1348 if (op & 4) channel |= ~color & destination;
1349 if (op & 8) channel |= ~color & ~destination;
1350 result |= channel & (0xffu << shift);
1351 }
1352 destination = (destination & ~mask) | (result & mask);
1353 }
1354}
1355
1356bool CRealImage2100::auxiliary_framebuffer_profile() const
1357{
1358 if ((peek(DrawControl) & ~0x00ff0f01u) != 0xa1004002u ||
1359 !native_copy_control_profile(true, true) || m_planes[2].unknown_masks)
1360 return false;
1361 const uint32_t expected[] = {0, 0, 0x0fff0fff, 0x03030303, 0x0a000000,
1362 0, 0, 0, 0, 0x00ff0000, 0x33300000, 0x100, 0, 0x100, 0};
1363 for (unsigned i = 0; i < std::size(expected); ++i)
1364 if (plane_value(2, i + 1, expected[i]) != expected[i] &&
1365 !(i == 9 && plane_value(2, i + 1, expected[i]) == 0))
1366 return false;
1367 return true;
1368}
1369
1370bool CRealImage2100::framebuffer_access(
1371 uint32_t a, int bits, uint32_t& value, bool write)
1372{
1373 if (a < 0x01000000 || a >= 0x04000000)
1374 return false;
1375 // Fixed front/back/auxiliary windows use an 8 KiB row pitch.
1376 const uint32_t bank = (a >> 24) - 1, x = (a & 0x1fff) >> 2,
1377 y = (a & 0x00ffffff) >> 13, shift = (a & 3) * 8,
1378 control = peek(DrawControl);
1379 const bool integer_rgb = bank < 2 && (control & ~0xff01u) == 0x21000002u &&
1380 ((control >> 12) & 15) == (1u << bank) && integer_rgb_profile();
1381 if ((bank == 2 ? write && !auxiliary_framebuffer_profile() :
1382 (!integer_rgb && !copy_profile()) || !plane_profile(bank)) ||
1383 x >= m_color_width || y >= m_color_height)
1384 {
1385 unimplemented_once("REALimage framebuffer aperture/profile", a, value, write);
1386 if (!write)
1387 value = width_mask(bits);
1388 return true;
1389 }
1390 if (bank == 2)
1391 {
1392 uint32_t& pixel = m_auxiliary[size_t(y) * m_color_width + x];
1393 if (write)
1394 {
1395 const uint32_t mask = plane_value(2, 0, 0xffffffff) & (width_mask(bits) << shift);
1396 pixel = (pixel & ~mask) | ((value << shift) & mask);
1397 m_clear_cache[2] = {};
1398 }
1399 else
1400 value = (pixel >> shift) & width_mask(bits);
1401 return true;
1402 }
1403 if (write)
1404 {
1405 execute_pixel(prepare_pixel(x, y, value << shift, 1u << bank,
1406 width_mask(bits) << shift, true));
1407 }
1408 else
1409 value = (m_color[size_t(bank) * m_color_pixels + y * m_color_width + x] >> shift) &
1410 width_mask(bits);
1411 return true;
1412}
1413
1414bool CRealImage2100::fill_profile(bool initialization) const
1415{
1416 const uint32_t control = peek(DrawControl), banks = (control >> 12) & 15;
1417 // Initialization can broadcast the rectangle to RGB and auxiliary planes.
1418 const bool bootstrap = initialization &&
1419 (control & ~0xff01u) == 0x05000002 && banks && !(banks & ~7u);
1420 const bool normal = (control & ~0x040fff01u) == 0x81000002 && banks && !(banks & ~3u);
1421 return (normal || bootstrap) && native_copy_control_profile(true);
1422}
1423
1424static bool block_pattern_layout(const std::array<uint32_t, 64>& values,
1425 uint32_t width, uint32_t mask)
1426{
1427 if (width != 16)
1428 return true;
1429 // Only the driver's replicated four-column pattern is decoded for 16-pixel blocks.
1430 for (unsigned i = 0; i < width * 4; ++i)
1431 if ((values[i] ^ values[(i & ~15u) | (i & 3u)]) & mask)
1432 return false;
1433 return true;
1434}
1435
1436CRealImage2100::BlockOperation CRealImage2100::prepare_block(uint32_t v) const
1437{
1438 BlockOperation op;
1439 op.value = v;
1440 op.color = prepare_color_write();
1441 const uint32_t control = peek(DrawControl), banks = (control >> 12) & 15,
1442 source = peek(BlockSource), destination = peek(BlockDestination),
1443 extent = peek(BlockExtent), auxiliary_mask = plane_value(2, 0, 0xffffffff),
1444 auxiliary_value = plane_clear_value(2, 0, 0);
1445 const bool copy = (v & 0x20000) != 0, configuration = (control & 0x04000000) != 0;
1446 const bool auxiliary_clear = (banks & 4) && auxiliary_mask;
1447 const bool seed = !configuration && !copy;
1448 const uint32_t clear_width = block_width(), groups = clear_width / 2,
1449 dx = destination & 0x7ff, dy = destination >> 16,
1450 width = (extent & 0x7ff) + 1, height = (extent >> 16) + 1,
1451 scale_x = copy ? 10 * clear_width : clear_width, scale_y = copy ? 16 : 4;
1452 op.banks = banks;
1453 op.source = source;
1454 op.clear_width = clear_width;
1455 op.groups = groups;
1456 op.x = dx * scale_x;
1457 op.y = dy * scale_y;
1458 op.right = op.x + width * scale_x;
1459 op.bottom = op.y + height * scale_y;
1460 op.seed_key = ((dy / 4) << 16) | (dx / 10);
1461 op.auxiliary_mask = auxiliary_mask;
1462 op.auxiliary_value = auxiliary_value;
1463 op.copy = copy;
1464 op.seed = seed;
1465 op.auxiliary_clear = auxiliary_clear;
1466 const uint32_t control_fields = 0x040fff01u;
1467 // Integer profiles retain the fourth byte used by the DAC overlay plane.
1468 const bool integer_clear = (control & ~0x0400ff01u) == 0xa1000002u;
1469 const bool integer_seed = integer_clear && seed;
1470 const bool integer_auxiliary = !copy && (control & ~0x04ff0f01u) == 0xa1004002u;
1471 op.allow_pattern = integer_clear && !(banks & ~3u);
1472 for (auto& mask : op.color.masks)
1473 mask &= integer_clear ? 0xffffffffu : 0x00ffffffu;
1474 if ((!integer_clear && !integer_auxiliary && (control & ~control_fields) != 0x81000002) ||
1475 (integer_clear && configuration && (banks & 4) && !integer_auxiliary) ||
1476 !banks || (banks & ~7u) ||
1477 v != (((banks ^ 7u) << 18) | (copy ? 0x30000u : 0x10000u)) ||
1478 !native_copy_control_profile(true) || m_pending.width || m_readback.width ||
1479 ((source | destination | extent) & ~0x07ff07ffu) ||
1480 (!copy && source) || (copy && !configuration))
1481 return op;
1482 op.geometry_known = true;
1483 if (seed && (extent != 0x00080014 || dx % 10 || dy % 4 ||
1484 (dx * clear_width < m_color_width && dy * 4 < m_color_height)))
1485 return op;
1486 if (auxiliary_clear)
1487 {
1488 const bool integer_packed = integer_seed || integer_auxiliary;
1489 const uint32_t depth_control = plane_value(2, 5, 0),
1490 format = integer_packed ? 0x100u : 0u;
1491 // The driver packs window references into the auxiliary clear source.
1492 const uint32_t references = ((control & 0x000f0000u) >> 4) |
1493 ((control & 0x00f00000u) << 8);
1494 if (integer_auxiliary && !(integer_seed && auxiliary_mask == 0xffffffffu) &&
1495 ((auxiliary_value ^ references) & auxiliary_mask & 0xf000f000u))
1496 return op;
1497 const bool neutral_clear = (!integer_auxiliary || integer_seed) &&
1498 plane_profile(2, 0) && plane_value(2, 10, 0) == 0 &&
1499 (auxiliary_mask == 0xffffffffu ||
1500 (configuration && !(auxiliary_mask & ~0x0000f000u)));
1501 const bool packed_clear = (auxiliary_mask == 0xffffffffu || integer_auxiliary) &&
1502 plane_value(2, 1, 0) == 0 && plane_value(2, 2, 0) == (integer_packed ? 0u : 0xf000u) &&
1503 plane_value(2, 3, 0) == 0x0fff0fff &&
1504 (integer_packed ? depth_control == 0x0a000000 :
1505 (depth_control == 0x0a000200 || depth_control == 0x0a000205 ||
1506 depth_control == 0x0a000207)) &&
1507 plane_value(2, 6, 0) == 0 && plane_value(2, 7, 0) == 0 &&
1508 plane_value(2, 8, 0) == 0 && plane_value(2, 9, 0) == 0 &&
1509 plane_value(2, 10, 0) == 0x00ff0000 &&
1510 plane_value(2, 11, 0x33300000) == 0x33300000 &&
1511 plane_value(2, 12, 0x100) == 0x100 && plane_value(2, 13, 0) == 0 &&
1512 plane_value(2, 14, format) == format && plane_value(2, 15, 0) == 0;
1513 if ((!neutral_clear && !packed_clear) ||
1514 plane_value(2, 4, 0x03030303) != 0x03030303 ||
1515 m_planes[2].unknown_masks)
1516 return op;
1517 for (unsigned i = 0; i < groups; ++i)
1518 {
1519 const uint32_t bits = plane_value(2, 24 + i, 0xffffffff);
1520 // Uniform offscreen seeds bypass retained configuration pixel masks.
1521 if (bits != (bits & 255) * 0x01010101u)
1522 return op;
1523 }
1524 }
1525 for (unsigned bank = 0; bank < 2; ++bank)
1526 {
1527 const uint32_t mask = op.color.masks[bank],
1528 rops = op.color.rops[bank];
1529 if (!(banks & (1u << bank)) || !mask)
1530 continue;
1531 const bool blend = rops == 0xd0d0d0d0;
1532 op.replace_color[bank] = blend || (!copy && (rops & 0xffffff) == 0x060606);
1533 if ((blend && (mask & 0xff000000)) ||
1534 !plane_profile(bank, 0x100, blend ? rops : 0) ||
1535 m_planes[bank].unknown_masks)
1536 return op;
1537 if (!copy)
1538 op.colors[bank] = plane_clear_value(bank, 0, 0);
1539 for (unsigned i = 0; i < groups; ++i)
1540 {
1541 const uint32_t bits = plane_value(bank, 24 + i, 0xffffffff);
1542 if (bits != (bits & 255) * 0x01010101u)
1543 return op;
1544 }
1545 }
1546 for (unsigned bank = 0; bank < 3; ++bank)
1547 {
1548 for (unsigned i = 0; i < groups; ++i)
1549 op.pixel_masks[bank][i] = plane_value(bank, 24 + i, 0xffffffff);
1550 const uint32_t mask = bank == 2 ? auxiliary_mask : op.color.masks[bank],
1551 first = bank == 2 ? auxiliary_value : op.colors[bank];
1552 if (copy || !(banks & (1u << bank)) || !mask)
1553 continue;
1554 for (unsigned y = 0; y < 4; ++y)
1555 for (unsigned x = 0; x < clear_width; ++x)
1556 {
1557 const unsigned group = x % groups, word = 2 * y + x / groups;
1558 if (!plane_clear_written(bank, group, word))
1559 return op;
1560 const uint32_t value = plane_clear_value(bank, group, word) & mask;
1561 op.clear_values[bank][y * clear_width + x] = value;
1562 op.patterned[bank] = op.patterned[bank] || value != (first & mask);
1563 }
1564 if (op.patterned[bank] && (!op.allow_pattern ||
1565 !block_pattern_layout(op.clear_values[bank], clear_width, mask)))
1566 return op;
1567 if (seed && (op.patterned[bank] || m_clear_cache[bank].patterned))
1568 for (unsigned group = 0; group < groups; ++group)
1569 if (op.pixel_masks[bank][group] != 0xffffffffu)
1570 return op;
1571 }
1572 op.valid = true;
1573 return op;
1574}
1575
1576void CRealImage2100::execute_block(const BlockOperation& op)
1577{
1578 if (!op.value)
1579 return;
1580 auto invalidate_cache = [&]() {
1581 for (unsigned bank = 0; bank < 3; ++bank)
1582 if (op.banks & (1u << bank))
1583 {
1584 auto& cache = m_clear_cache[bank];
1585 const uint32_t cx = (cache.source & 0xffff) * 10 * op.clear_width,
1586 cy = (cache.source >> 16) * 16;
1587 if (!op.geometry_known ||
1588 (op.x < cx + 21 * op.clear_width && op.right > cx &&
1589 op.y < cy + 36 && op.bottom > cy))
1590 cache = {};
1591 }
1592 };
1593 auto reject = [&]() {
1594 invalidate_cache();
1595 unimplemented_once("REALimage block command/profile (command rejected)",
1596 BlockCommand, op.value, true);
1597 };
1598 if (!op.valid)
1599 {
1600 reject();
1601 return;
1602 }
1603 std::array<uint32_t, 3> colors = {op.colors[0], op.colors[1], op.auxiliary_value};
1604 auto clear_values = op.clear_values;
1605 auto patterned = op.patterned;
1606 for (unsigned bank = 0; bank < 3; ++bank)
1607 {
1608 const uint32_t mask = bank == 2 ? op.auxiliary_mask : op.color.masks[bank];
1609 if (!(op.banks & (1u << bank)) || !mask)
1610 continue;
1611 if (op.copy)
1612 {
1613 const auto& cache = m_clear_cache[bank];
1614 if (cache.source != op.source || (cache.known & mask) != mask)
1615 {
1616 reject();
1617 return;
1618 }
1619 colors[bank] = cache.color;
1620 patterned[bank] = cache.patterned;
1621 clear_values[bank] = cache.pattern;
1622 if (patterned[bank])
1623 {
1624 patterned[bank] = false;
1625 for (unsigned i = 0; i < op.clear_width * 4; ++i)
1626 patterned[bank] = patterned[bank] || ((cache.pattern[i] ^ cache.color) & mask);
1627 }
1628 }
1629 if (patterned[bank] && (!op.allow_pattern ||
1630 !block_pattern_layout(clear_values[bank], op.clear_width, mask)))
1631 {
1632 reject();
1633 return;
1634 }
1635 if (bank == 2 || op.seed)
1636 continue;
1637 const uint32_t rops = op.color.rops[bank];
1638 for (unsigned pixel = 0; pixel < (patterned[bank] ? op.clear_width * 4 : 1); ++pixel)
1639 {
1640 const uint32_t value = patterned[bank] ? clear_values[bank][pixel] : colors[bank];
1641 for (unsigned shift = 0; shift < 32; shift += 8)
1642 if (!(op.replace_color[bank] && shift < 24 && !patterned[bank]) &&
1643 (mask & (0xffu << shift)) && ((rops >> shift) & 15) != 3 &&
1644 (((rops >> shift) & 15) != 0 || (value & mask & (0xffu << shift))))
1645 {
1646 reject();
1647 return;
1648 }
1649 }
1650 }
1651 if (op.seed)
1652 {
1653 for (unsigned bank = 0; bank < 3; ++bank)
1654 if (op.banks & (1u << bank))
1655 {
1656 const uint32_t mask = bank == 2 ? op.auxiliary_mask : op.color.masks[bank];
1657 if (!mask)
1658 continue;
1659 auto& cache = m_clear_cache[bank];
1660 if (cache.source != op.seed_key)
1661 cache = {};
1662 cache.source = op.seed_key;
1663 if (cache.patterned || patterned[bank])
1664 {
1665 const bool old_patterned = cache.patterned;
1666 cache.patterned = false;
1667 for (unsigned i = 0; i < op.clear_width * 4; ++i)
1668 {
1669 const uint32_t old = old_patterned ? cache.pattern[i] : cache.color,
1670 value = patterned[bank] ? clear_values[bank][i] : colors[bank];
1671 cache.pattern[i] = (old & ~mask) | (value & mask);
1672 cache.patterned = cache.patterned || cache.pattern[i] != cache.pattern[0];
1673 }
1674 cache.color = cache.pattern[0];
1675 if (!cache.patterned)
1676 cache.pattern = {};
1677 }
1678 else
1679 cache.color = (cache.color & ~mask) | (colors[bank] & mask);
1680 cache.known |= mask;
1681 }
1682 return;
1683 }
1684 invalidate_cache();
1685 const uint32_t right = std::min(op.right, m_color_width),
1686 bottom = std::min(op.bottom, m_color_height);
1687 if (op.x >= right || op.y >= bottom)
1688 return;
1689 // Validated block ROPs reduce to masked replacement, including zero-source clears.
1690 for (unsigned bank = 0; bank < 3; ++bank)
1691 {
1692 if (bank == 2 ? !op.auxiliary_clear : !(op.banks & (1u << bank)))
1693 continue;
1694 const uint32_t mask = bank == 2 ? op.auxiliary_mask : op.color.masks[bank],
1695 value = colors[bank];
1696 if (!mask)
1697 continue;
1698 uint32_t* const pixels = bank == 2 ? m_auxiliary.data() :
1699 m_color.data() + size_t(bank) * m_color_pixels;
1700 std::array<std::array<uint32_t, 16>, 4> masks{};
1701 std::array<bool, 4> full{}, empty{};
1702 for (unsigned y = 0; y < 4; ++y)
1703 {
1704 full[y] = empty[y] = true;
1705 for (unsigned x = 0; x < op.clear_width; ++x)
1706 {
1707 const uint32_t bits = (op.pixel_masks[bank][x % op.groups] &
1708 (1u << (2 * y + x / op.groups))) ? mask : 0;
1709 masks[y][x] = bits;
1710 full[y] = full[y] && bits == 0xffffffffu;
1711 empty[y] = empty[y] && !bits;
1712 }
1713 }
1714 for (uint32_t row = op.y; row < bottom; ++row)
1715 {
1716 if (empty[row & 3])
1717 continue;
1718 uint32_t* const line = pixels + size_t(row) * m_color_width;
1719 if (patterned[bank])
1720 {
1721 for (uint32_t col = op.x; col < right; ++col)
1722 {
1723 const unsigned x = col & (op.clear_width - 1);
1724 const uint32_t lanes = masks[row & 3][x],
1725 source = clear_values[bank][(row & 3) * op.clear_width + x];
1726 line[col] = (line[col] & ~lanes) | (source & lanes);
1727 }
1728 continue;
1729 }
1730 if (full[row & 3])
1731 {
1732 std::fill(line + op.x, line + right, value);
1733 continue;
1734 }
1735 const auto& row_masks = masks[row & 3];
1736 uint32_t col = op.x;
1737#if defined(REALIMAGE_SSE2)
1738 const __m128i values = _mm_set1_epi32(value);
1739 for (; col + 4 <= right; col += 4)
1740 {
1741 const __m128i lanes = _mm_loadu_si128(reinterpret_cast<const __m128i*>(
1742 row_masks.data() + (col & (op.clear_width - 1))));
1743 const __m128i old = _mm_loadu_si128(reinterpret_cast<const __m128i*>(line + col));
1744 _mm_storeu_si128(reinterpret_cast<__m128i*>(line + col),
1745 _mm_or_si128(_mm_andnot_si128(lanes, old), _mm_and_si128(lanes, values)));
1746 }
1747#endif
1748 for (; col < right; ++col)
1749 {
1750 const uint32_t lanes = row_masks[col & (op.clear_width - 1)];
1751 line[col] = (line[col] & ~lanes) | (value & lanes);
1752 }
1753 }
1754 }
1755}
1756
1757void CRealImage2100::block_command(uint32_t v)
1758{
1759 if (v == 0x01000032 || v == 0x07000032 || v == 0x01000052 || v == 0x07000052 || v == 0x01000072 ||
1760 v == 0x07000072 || v == 0x06000072 || v == 0x06000062 || v == 0x07000062 ||
1761 v == 0x06200062 || v == 0x06200072 || v == 0x07200062 || v == 0x07200072)
1762 start_command(BlockCommand, v);
1763 else
1764 execute_block(prepare_block(v));
1765}
1766
1767CRealImage2100::StartPrefix CRealImage2100::begin_start(uint32_t a, uint32_t v)
1768{
1769 const bool native_readback = a == BlockCommand && v == 0x07000052;
1770 const bool readback = ((a == HostCommand || a == BlockCommand) && v == 0x01000052) || native_readback;
1771 const bool cross_copy = a == HostCommand &&
1772 (v == 0x01008072 || v == 0x00008062 || v == 0x00008072 || v == 0x01008062);
1773 const uint32_t selected = (peek(DrawControl) >> 12) & 3;
1774 const uint32_t destination_banks = cross_copy ?
1775 ((selected >> 1) | (selected << 1)) & 3 : selected;
1776 if (!readback)
1777 for (unsigned bank = 0; bank < 2; ++bank)
1778 if (destination_banks & (1u << bank))
1779 m_clear_cache[bank] = {};
1780 if (((a == FillCommand && (v == 0x09040832 || v == 0x010408b2)) || a == BitmapCommand ||
1781 (a == HostCommand && v == 0x010008f2 && (peek(DrawControl) & 0xf000) == 0x4000) ||
1782 (a == BlockCommand && (v == 0x07000072 || v == 0x06000072 || v == 0x06000062 || v == 0x07000062))) &&
1783 (peek(DrawControl) & 0x4000))
1784 m_clear_cache[2] = {};
1785 if (m_pending.width)
1786 report("HOST_INTERRUPTED", a, v, "Incomplete native host upload replaced");
1787 if (m_readback.width)
1788 report("READBACK_INTERRUPTED", a, v, "Incomplete native host readback replaced");
1789 m_pending = {};
1790 m_readback = {};
1791 return {a, v, selected, destination_banks};
1792}
1793
1794CRealImage2100::StartOperation CRealImage2100::prepare_start(const StartPrefix& prefix) const
1795{
1796 const uint32_t a = prefix.address, v = prefix.value;
1797 StartOperation op;
1798 op.address = a;
1799 op.value = v;
1800 op.color = prepare_color_write();
1801 const bool native_upload = a == BlockCommand && v == 0x07000032;
1802 const bool native_readback = a == BlockCommand && v == 0x07000052;
1803 const bool readback = ((a == HostCommand || a == BlockCommand) && v == 0x01000052) || native_readback;
1804 const bool cross_copy = a == HostCommand &&
1805 (v == 0x01008072 || v == 0x00008062 || v == 0x00008072 || v == 0x01008062);
1806 const uint32_t selected = prefix.selected;
1807 op.banks = selected;
1808 op.destination_banks = prefix.destination_banks;
1809 if (!v)
1810 return op;
1811 op.kind = StartOperation::Kind::Rejected;
1812 const bool block_transfer = a == BlockCommand && (v == 0x01000032 || native_upload || readback);
1813 const bool block_fast_copy = a == BlockCommand &&
1814 (v == 0x06200062 || v == 0x06200072 || v == 0x07200062 || v == 0x07200072);
1815 const bool block_copy = block_fast_copy || (a == BlockCommand &&
1816 (v == 0x01000072 || v == 0x07000072 || v == 0x06000072 || v == 0x06000062 || v == 0x07000062));
1817 const bool block_geometry = block_transfer || block_copy;
1818 const bool upload = ((a == HostCommand || a == BlockCommand) && v == 0x01000032) || native_upload;
1819 const bool fast_copy = block_fast_copy || (a == HostCommand &&
1820 (v == 0x00200062 || v == 0x00200072 || v == 0x01200062 || v == 0x01200072));
1821 const bool copy = (a == HostCommand &&
1822 (v == 0x01000062 || v == 0x00000062 || v == 0x01000072 || v == 0x00000072)) ||
1823 fast_copy || cross_copy || block_copy;
1824 const bool initialization = a == FillCommand &&
1825 (v == 0x09040832 || v == 0x010408b2);
1826 const bool fill = a == FillCommand && (v == 0x09000832 || v == 0x09040832);
1827 const bool repeated_mono = a == FillCommand && (v == 0x01000872 || v == 0x010008f2);
1828 const bool bitmap = a == BitmapCommand && v == 0x01000872;
1829 const bool host_mono = a == HostCommand && (v & ~0x7780u) == 0x01000872;
1830 const bool auxiliary_mono = a == HostCommand && v == 0x010008f2 &&
1831 (peek(DrawControl) & 0xf000) == 0x4000;
1832 const bool configuration_mono = a == HostCommand && v == 0x010008f2 &&
1833 (peek(DrawControl) & 0xff000000u) == 0xa5000000u &&
1834 (peek(DrawControl) & 0xf000) != 0x4000;
1835 const bool integer_mono = configuration_mono ||
1836 (a == HostCommand && (v & ~0x700u) == 0x01000872 &&
1837 ((peek(DrawControl) & 0xe0000000u) == 0xa0000000u ||
1838 (peek(DrawControl) & ~0xff01u) == 0x21000002u));
1839 op.transparent = bitmap || ((host_mono || repeated_mono) && !(v & 0x80));
1840 op.mono_offset = host_mono ? (v >> 8) & 7 : 0;
1841 // Integer glyphs encode only the source offset; their extent supplies the width.
1842 const uint32_t mono_width = host_mono && !integer_mono && (v & 0x7700) ? ((v >> 12) & 7) + 1 : 0;
1843 op.mono = bitmap || host_mono || repeated_mono || (a == FillCommand && v == 0x010408b2);
1844 op.auxiliary = (initialization || bitmap || block_copy || auxiliary_mono) && (peek(DrawControl) & 0x4000);
1845 const bool profile = auxiliary_mono ? auxiliary_mono_profile() :
1846 integer_mono ? integer_rgb_profile(configuration_mono) : bitmap ? bitmap_profile() :
1847 fast_copy ? fast_copy_profile(block_fast_copy) :
1848 block_copy ? (v == 0x01000072 ?
1849 block_transfer_profile(false) : block_copy_profile()) :
1850 block_transfer ? block_transfer_profile(upload, native_readback || native_upload) :
1851 ((fill || initialization) ? fill_profile(initialization) : copy_profile()) &&
1852 (!(selected & 1) || plane_profile(0)) && (!(selected & 2) || plane_profile(1)) &&
1853 (!op.auxiliary || plane_profile(2)) &&
1854 (!cross_copy || plane_profile(selected == 2 ? 0 : 1));
1855 if ((!upload && !copy && !fill && !op.mono && !readback) || !profile ||
1856 ((copy || readback || native_upload) && selected != 1 && selected != 2))
1857 return op;
1858 // Bit 18 selects host geometry for the miniport's initialization rectangles.
1859 const bool host_geometry = a == HostCommand || initialization;
1860 const uint32_t origin = peek(block_geometry ? (readback ? BlockSource : BlockDestination) :
1861 bitmap ? BitmapOrigin : host_geometry ? HostOrigin : FillOrigin),
1862 extent = peek(block_geometry ? BlockExtent : bitmap ? BitmapExtent : host_geometry ? HostExtent : FillExtent),
1863 width = (extent & 0xffff) + 1, height = (extent >> 16) + 1;
1864 op.width = width;
1865 op.height = height;
1866 op.banks = (peek(DrawControl) >> 12) & 3;
1867 op.x = int16_t(origin & 0xffff);
1868 op.y = int16_t(origin >> 16);
1869 if ((block_transfer || integer_mono || auxiliary_mono) && (op.x < 0 || op.y < 0 ||
1870 uint64_t(op.x) + width > m_color_width || uint64_t(op.y) + height > m_color_height))
1871 return op;
1872 if (readback)
1873 {
1874 const uint32_t source = peek(BlockSource), sx = source & 0xffff,
1875 sy = source >> 16;
1876 if (sx >= m_color_width || sy >= m_color_height ||
1877 width > m_color_width - sx || height > m_color_height - sy)
1878 {
1879 op.rejection = StartOperation::Rejection::ReadbackSource;
1880 return op;
1881 }
1882 op.kind = StartOperation::Kind::Readback;
1883 op.banks = selected;
1884 op.sx = int32_t(sx);
1885 op.sy = int32_t(sy);
1886 return op;
1887 }
1888 if (upload)
1889 {
1890 if (uint64_t(width) * height > 0xffffffffu)
1891 {
1892 op.rejection = StartOperation::Rejection::HostBounds;
1893 return op;
1894 }
1895 if (block_transfer && (peek(DrawControl) & 0x4000))
1896 {
1897 op.auxiliary_compare_mask = 0x8000;
1898 op.auxiliary_reference = (peek(DrawControl) >> 4) & op.auxiliary_compare_mask;
1899 }
1900 op.kind = StartOperation::Kind::Upload;
1901 return op;
1902 }
1903 if (copy)
1904 {
1905 const uint32_t source = peek(BlockSource);
1906 op.source_bank = selected == 2 ? 1 : 0;
1907 op.destination_bank = cross_copy ? op.source_bank ^ 1u : op.source_bank;
1908 op.right_to_left = !(v & 0x01000000);
1909 op.bottom_to_top = !(v & 0x10);
1910 op.fast_copy = fast_copy;
1911 if (fast_copy && ((source ^ origin) & (block_width() / 2 - 1)))
1912 {
1913 op.rejection = StartOperation::Rejection::CopyAlignment;
1914 return op;
1915 }
1916 op.sx = int16_t(source & 0xffff);
1917 op.sy = int16_t(source >> 16);
1918 op.left = op.right_to_left ? op.x - int32_t(width) + 1 : op.x;
1919 op.right = op.x + (op.right_to_left ? 1 : int32_t(width));
1920 op.top = op.bottom_to_top ? op.y - int32_t(height) + 1 : op.y;
1921 op.bottom = op.y + (op.bottom_to_top ? 0 : int32_t(height) - 1);
1922 if (block_copy && (op.left < 0 || op.top < 0 || op.right > int32_t(m_color_width) ||
1923 op.bottom >= int32_t(m_color_height)))
1924 return op;
1925 op.left = std::max(op.left, int32_t(0));
1926 op.right = std::min(op.right, int32_t(m_color_width));
1927 op.top = std::max(op.top, int32_t(0));
1928 op.bottom = std::min(op.bottom, int32_t(m_color_height) - 1);
1929 if (op.left >= op.right || op.top > op.bottom)
1930 {
1931 op.kind = StartOperation::Kind::Empty;
1932 return op;
1933 }
1934 if (op.sx + op.left - op.x < 0 || op.sx + op.right - op.x > int32_t(m_color_width) ||
1935 op.sy + op.top - op.y < 0 || op.sy + op.bottom - op.y >= int32_t(m_color_height))
1936 {
1937 op.rejection = StartOperation::Rejection::CopySource;
1938 return op;
1939 }
1940 if (op.auxiliary)
1941 op.auxiliary_mask = plane_value(2, 0, 0xffffffff);
1942 op.kind = StartOperation::Kind::Copy;
1943 return op;
1944 }
1945 // Bitmap rows start in the higher-addressed pattern word.
1946 op.pattern = bitmap ? std::array<uint32_t, 4>{0, 0, peek(BitmapPattern0), peek(BitmapPattern1)} :
1947 std::array<uint32_t, 4>{peek(MonoPattern0), peek(MonoPattern1), peek(MonoPattern2), peek(MonoPattern3)};
1948 // Native rectangle fills can repeat one word beyond the glyph limits.
1949 const bool repeated_host = configuration_mono && op.pattern[0] == op.pattern[1] &&
1950 op.pattern[0] == op.pattern[2] && op.pattern[0] == op.pattern[3];
1951 // Multirow bitmap layouts are accepted only when the two possible row pitches agree.
1952 if (op.mono && ((mono_width && width != mono_width) ||
1953 (a == HostCommand && !auxiliary_mono && !repeated_host &&
1954 (width + op.mono_offset > 8 || height > 16)) ||
1955 (bitmap && (width > 8 || (height != 1 &&
1956 (width != 2 || height != 2 || ((op.pattern[3] ^ (op.pattern[3] >> 6)) & 0x00c00000u))))) ||
1957 (a == FillCommand && (op.pattern[0] != op.pattern[2] || op.pattern[1] != op.pattern[3]))))
1958 {
1959 op.rejection = StartOperation::Rejection::MonoLayout;
1960 return op;
1961 }
1962 op.left = std::max(op.x, int32_t(0));
1963 op.top = std::max(op.y, int32_t(0));
1964 op.right = std::min(op.x + int32_t(width), int32_t(m_color_width));
1965 op.bottom = std::min(op.y + int32_t(height), int32_t(m_color_height));
1966 op.foreground = peek(bitmap ? BitmapForeground : Foreground);
1967 op.background = peek(bitmap ? BitmapBackground : Background);
1968 if (bitmap)
1969 {
1970 op.left = std::max(op.left, int32_t(peek(ClipXMin) >> 4));
1971 op.top = std::max(op.top, int32_t(peek(ClipYMin) >> 4));
1972 op.right = std::min(op.right, int32_t((peek(ClipXMax) >> 4) + 1));
1973 op.bottom = std::min(op.bottom, int32_t((peek(ClipYMax) >> 4) + 1));
1974 }
1975 if (bitmap || integer_mono || auxiliary_mono)
1976 {
1977 op.auxiliary_reference = ((peek(DrawControl) & 0x00f00000u) << 8) |
1978 ((peek(DrawControl) & 0x000f0000u) >> 4);
1979 }
1980 // Auxiliary payload and window references occupy separate packed fields.
1981 if (auxiliary_mono)
1982 op.foreground = op.background = (op.foreground & 0x0fff0fffu) | op.auxiliary_reference;
1983 if (integer_mono && (peek(DrawControl) & 0x4000))
1984 op.auxiliary_compare_mask = 0x8000;
1985 if (op.auxiliary)
1986 {
1987 op.auxiliary_mask = plane_value(2, 0, 0xffffffff);
1988 op.auxiliary_rop = plane_value(2, 4, 0x03030303);
1989 }
1990 op.kind = StartOperation::Kind::Pattern;
1991 return op;
1992}
1993
1994void CRealImage2100::execute_start(const StartOperation& op)
1995{
1996 if (op.kind == StartOperation::Kind::Empty)
1997 return;
1998 if (op.kind == StartOperation::Kind::Rejected)
1999 {
2000 const char* message = "REALimage 2D command/profile (command rejected)";
2001 switch (op.rejection)
2002 {
2003 case StartOperation::Rejection::ReadbackSource:
2004 message = "REALimage readback source bounds (command rejected)";
2005 break;
2006 case StartOperation::Rejection::HostBounds:
2007 report("HOST_BOUNDS", op.address, op.value, "Native host extent exceeds model limit");
2008 return;
2009 case StartOperation::Rejection::CopyAlignment:
2010 message = "REALimage fast-copy alignment (command rejected)";
2011 break;
2012 case StartOperation::Rejection::CopySource:
2013 message = "REALimage copy source bounds (command rejected)";
2014 break;
2015 case StartOperation::Rejection::MonoLayout:
2016 message = "REALimage monochrome layout (command rejected)";
2017 break;
2018 default:
2019 break;
2020 }
2021 unimplemented_once(message, op.address, op.value, true);
2022 return;
2023 }
2024 if (op.kind == StartOperation::Kind::Readback)
2025 {
2026 m_readback = {uint32_t(op.sx), uint32_t(op.sy), op.width, op.height, 0, op.banks};
2027 return;
2028 }
2029 if (op.kind == StartOperation::Kind::Upload)
2030 {
2031 m_pending = {uint32_t(op.x) & 0xffff, uint32_t(op.y) & 0xffff,
2032 op.width, op.height, 0, op.banks, op.auxiliary_compare_mask, op.auxiliary_reference};
2033 return;
2034 }
2035 if (op.kind == StartOperation::Kind::Copy)
2036 {
2037 const int32_t first = op.right_to_left ? op.right - 1 : op.left,
2038 end = op.right_to_left ? op.left - 1 : op.right, step = op.right_to_left ? -1 : 1,
2039 first_row = op.bottom_to_top ? op.bottom : op.top,
2040 end_row = op.bottom_to_top ? op.top - 1 : op.bottom + 1,
2041 row_step = op.bottom_to_top ? -1 : 1;
2042 for (int32_t row = first_row; row != end_row; row += row_step)
2043 for (int32_t col = first; col != end; col += step)
2044 {
2045 const size_t offset = size_t(op.source_bank) * m_color_pixels +
2046 size_t(op.sy + row - op.y) * m_color_width + size_t(op.sx + col - op.x);
2047 if (op.fast_copy)
2048 {
2049 uint32_t& destination = m_color[size_t(op.destination_bank) * m_color_pixels +
2050 size_t(row) * m_color_width + col];
2051 destination = (destination & 0xff000000) | (m_color[offset] & 0xffffff);
2052 }
2053 else
2054 color_write(op.color, uint32_t(col), uint32_t(row), m_color[offset], op.destination_banks);
2055 if (op.auxiliary)
2056 {
2057 const uint32_t source = m_auxiliary[size_t(op.sy + row - op.y) * m_color_width +
2058 size_t(op.sx + col - op.x)];
2059 uint32_t& destination = m_auxiliary[size_t(row) * m_color_width + col];
2060 destination = (destination & ~op.auxiliary_mask) | (source & op.auxiliary_mask);
2061 }
2062 }
2063 return;
2064 }
2065 for (int32_t row = op.top; row < op.bottom; ++row)
2066 for (int32_t col = op.left; col < op.right; ++col)
2067 {
2068 uint32_t color = op.foreground;
2069 if (op.mono)
2070 {
2071 const uint32_t px = (uint32_t(col - op.x) + op.mono_offset) & 7,
2072 py = uint32_t(row - op.y) & 15;
2073 if (!(op.pattern[3 - py / 4] & (1u << (31 - 8 * (py & 3) - px))))
2074 {
2075 if (op.transparent)
2076 continue;
2077 color = op.background;
2078 }
2079 }
2080 if (op.auxiliary_compare_mask &&
2081 ((m_auxiliary[size_t(row) * m_color_width + col] ^ op.auxiliary_reference) & op.auxiliary_compare_mask))
2082 continue;
2083 color_write(op.color, uint32_t(col), uint32_t(row), color, op.banks);
2084 if (op.auxiliary)
2085 {
2086 uint32_t& destination = m_auxiliary[size_t(row) * m_color_width + col];
2087 // Auxiliary bitmap tag bits come from DrawControl.
2088 const uint32_t source = op.address == BitmapCommand ? op.auxiliary_reference : color;
2089 uint32_t result = 0;
2090 for (unsigned shift = 0; shift < 32; shift += 8)
2091 {
2092 const unsigned rop = (op.auxiliary_rop >> shift) & 15;
2093 uint32_t channel = 0;
2094 if (rop & 1) channel |= source & destination;
2095 if (rop & 2) channel |= source & ~destination;
2096 if (rop & 4) channel |= ~source & destination;
2097 if (rop & 8) channel |= ~source & ~destination;
2098 result |= channel & (0xffu << shift);
2099 }
2100 destination = (destination & ~op.auxiliary_mask) | (result & op.auxiliary_mask);
2101 }
2102 }
2103}
2104
2105void CRealImage2100::start_command(uint32_t a, uint32_t v)
2106{
2107 const auto prefix = begin_start(a, v);
2108 execute_start(prepare_start(prefix));
2109}
2110
2111bool CRealImage2100::triangle_profile() const
2112{
2113 const uint32_t pipeline = peek(PipelineControl0), depth_control = plane_value(2, 5, 0),
2114 texture_format = pipeline & 0x0f007000u, texture_mode = pipeline & 0x00038000u;
2115 const bool textured = (pipeline & 0x80000000u) != 0,
2116 no_depth = depth_control == 0x0a000200;
2117 // Disabled texturing retains its format, filtering, wrapping and size fields.
2118 constexpr uint32_t texture_fields = 0x0f7fffff;
2119 if ((pipeline & ~(0x80000000u | texture_fields)) ||
2120 (textured && ((pipeline & ~0x0f03fffcu) != 0x804c0000u ||
2121 (texture_format != 0x0a002000u && texture_format != 0x09003000u &&
2122 texture_format != 0x0d002000u && texture_format != 0x0d003000u) ||
2123 texture_mode > 0x00018000u ||
2124 ((pipeline >> 8) & 15) > 10 || ((pipeline >> 4) & 15) > 10)))
2125 return false;
2126 const uint32_t control = peek(DrawControl), banks = (control >> 12) & 15,
2127 bank = (banks & 3) == 2 ? 1 : 0,
2128 global = peek(GlobalControl0),
2129 width = block_width(), columns = (control >> 8) & 15,
2130 copy_columns = ((peek(MemoryControl) >> 24) & 63) + 1,
2131 blend_control = peek(PipelineControl2), color_rop = plane_value(bank, 4, 0);
2132 const bool additive = color_rop == 0x10101010u || color_rop == 0xb0b0b0b0u,
2133 blend = additive || color_rop == 0xd0d0d0d0u;
2134 if (additive)
2135 {
2136 if (blend_control != 0x10000000u &&
2137 (color_rop != 0x10101010u || blend_control != 0x30000000u))
2138 return false;
2139 }
2140 else if (blend ? ((blend_control & ~0x30000080u) || !(blend_control & 0x30000000u)) :
2141 blend_control != 0x10000000u)
2142 return false;
2143 if ((control & ~0x000fff01u) != 0x81800002 || (banks != 5 && banks != 6) ||
2144 (global != 0x180 && global != 0x190) ||
2145 !native_pixel_profile() || !width || columns != (copy_columns + 1) / 2 ||
2146 copy_columns > (m_color_width + 10 * width - 1) / (10 * width) ||
2147 m_pending.width || m_readback.width)
2148 return false;
2149 if (textured && !no_depth && global != 0x190)
2150 return false;
2151 if (textured)
2152 {
2153 const uint32_t base = peek(TextureBase), texture_width = 1u << ((pipeline >> 8) & 15),
2154 texture_height = 1u << ((pipeline >> 4) & 15),
2155 texel_bytes = (texture_format & 0x0f000000u) == 0x0d000000u ? 4 : 2,
2156 row_bytes = m_texture.size() == MaxTextureSize ? 0x4000 : 0x2000;
2157 if ((base & (texel_bytes - 1)) || (base & 0x3fff) + texture_width * texel_bytes > row_bytes ||
2158 uint64_t(base) + (texture_height - 1) * 0x4000 + texture_width * texel_bytes > MaxTextureSize)
2159 return false;
2160 }
2161 const std::pair<uint32_t, uint32_t> profile[] = {
2162 {GlobalControl1, 0x20800}, {GlobalControl2, 0x33},
2163 {PipelineControl3, 0},
2164 {0x008005cc, 0}, {0x008005d4, 0}, {0x008005dc, 0}, {ContextControl, 0}};
2165 for (const auto& reg : profile)
2166 if (peek(reg.first) != reg.second)
2167 return false;
2168 if ((peek(ClipXMin) | peek(ClipXMax) | peek(ClipYMin) | peek(ClipYMax)) & 0xffff000fu)
2169 return false;
2170 // SRC_ALPHA + ONE uses the driver's dedicated plane multiplier.
2171 if (!plane_profile(bank, 0x100, blend ? color_rop : 0,
2172 color_rop == 0xb0b0b0b0u ? 0x19090909u : 0) ||
2173 plane_value(bank, 0, 0) != 0xffffffffu ||
2174 (!blend && color_rop != 0x03030303u) ||
2175 plane_value(bank, 10, 0) != 0 ||
2176 (no_depth ? depth_control != 0x0a000200 :
2177 (depth_control != 0x0a000205 && depth_control != 0x0a000207)))
2178 return false;
2179 const uint32_t depth[] = {no_depth ? 0u : 0x0fff0fffu, 0, 0xf000, 0x0fff0fff,
2180 0x03030303, depth_control, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0x00ff0000, 0x33300000};
2181 for (unsigned i = 0; i < std::size(depth); ++i)
2182 if (plane_value(2, i, 0) != depth[i])
2183 return false;
2184 if (plane_value(2, 12, 0x100) != 0x100 || plane_value(2, 13, 0) ||
2185 plane_value(2, 14, 0) || plane_value(2, 15, 0))
2186 return false;
2187 for (unsigned plane : {bank, 2u})
2188 {
2189 if (m_planes[plane].unknown_masks)
2190 return false;
2191 for (unsigned i = 24; i < 24 + width / 2; ++i)
2192 if (plane_value(plane, i, 0xffffffff) != 0xffffffffu)
2193 return false;
2194 }
2195 return true;
2196}
2197
2198CRealImage2100::TrianglePreparation CRealImage2100::prepare_triangle(
2199 uint32_t address, uint32_t value, TriangleOperation& operation) const
2200{
2201 // These commands retain the slot without launching a primitive.
2202 if (!value || value == 0x10)
2203 return TrianglePreparation::NoOp;
2204 const uint32_t pipeline = peek(PipelineControl0), texture_mode = pipeline & 0x00038000u,
2205 bank = ((peek(DrawControl) >> 12) & 3) == 2 ? 1 : 0,
2206 color_rop = plane_value(bank, 4, 0),
2207 source_blend = color_rop == 0xb0b0b0b0u ? 2 : peek(PipelineControl2) >> 28;
2208 const bool textured = (pipeline & 0x80000000u) != 0,
2209 flat = flat_vertex_register(address), no_depth = plane_value(2, 5, 0) == 0x0a000200,
2210 additive = color_rop == 0x10101010u || color_rop == 0xb0b0b0b0u,
2211 blend = additive || color_rop == 0xd0d0d0d0u, affine = peek(GlobalControl0) == 0x190,
2212 texture_alpha = (pipeline & 0x00007000u) == 0x00003000u,
2213 use_color = !textured || texture_mode == 0x8000 || texture_mode == 0x10000 ||
2214 (texture_mode == 0 && texture_alpha),
2215 use_alpha = blend && (!additive || source_blend != 1) &&
2216 !(textured && texture_alpha && texture_mode == 0x18000),
2217 use_w = textured && !affine;
2218 // Untextured perspective draws retain the existing linear depth approximation.
2219 if (value != 0x13 || !triangle_profile())
2220 {
2221 return TrianglePreparation::Rejected;
2222 }
2223 using Vertex = TriangleOperation::Vertex;
2224 Vertex vertex[3]{};
2225 for (unsigned slot = 0; slot < 3; ++slot)
2226 {
2227 double component[7]{};
2228 for (unsigned i = 0; i < 7; ++i)
2229 {
2230 if ((i == 0 && (flat || !use_alpha)) ||
2231 (i > 0 && i < 4 && (flat || !use_color)) || (i == 6 && no_depth && !use_w))
2232 continue;
2233 const auto reg = m_shadow.find(VertexBase + slot * VertexStride + i * 4);
2234 if (reg == m_shadow.end())
2235 {
2236 return TrianglePreparation::Rejected;
2237 }
2238 float input;
2239 static_assert(sizeof(input) == sizeof(reg->second), "IEEE vertex word size");
2240 std::memcpy(&input, &reg->second, sizeof(input));
2241 if (!std::isfinite(input) ||
2242 (i == 0 && (input < 0 || input > 256)) ||
2243 ((i == 4 || i == 5) && (input < -32768 || input >= 32768)) ||
2244 (i == 6 && (use_w ? input == 0 : (input < 0 || input > 1))))
2245 {
2246 return TrianglePreparation::Rejected;
2247 }
2248 // Lighting can emit overrange RGB; clamp before interpolation.
2249 component[i] = i > 0 && i < 4 ? std::clamp(double(input), 0.0, 256.0) : input;
2250 }
2251 vertex[slot] = {component[0], component[1], component[2], component[3],
2252 component[4], component[5], component[6], 0, 0};
2253 if (textured)
2254 {
2255 // Optimized driver packets leave the leading texture word unwritten.
2256 float coordinates[4];
2257 for (unsigned i = 1; i < 4; ++i)
2258 {
2259 const auto reg = m_shadow.find(VertexTextureBase + slot * VertexStride + i * 4);
2260 if (reg == m_shadow.end())
2261 {
2262 return TrianglePreparation::Rejected;
2263 }
2264 std::memcpy(&coordinates[i], &reg->second, sizeof(float));
2265 if (!std::isfinite(coordinates[i]))
2266 {
2267 return TrianglePreparation::Rejected;
2268 }
2269 }
2270 if (coordinates[3] != 0)
2271 {
2272 return TrianglePreparation::Rejected;
2273 }
2274 vertex[slot].s = coordinates[1];
2275 vertex[slot].t = coordinates[2];
2276 }
2277 }
2278 // The shared projection scale can be negative; reject a horizon crossing.
2279 if (use_w && ((vertex[0].z < 0) != (vertex[1].z < 0) ||
2280 (vertex[0].z < 0) != (vertex[2].z < 0)))
2281 {
2282 return TrianglePreparation::Rejected;
2283 }
2284 double flat_color[4]{};
2285 if (flat && (use_color || use_alpha))
2286 {
2287 // The launching slot supplies flat color, regardless of winding.
2288 const uint32_t slot = (address - FlatVertexBase) / VertexStride;
2289 for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
2290 {
2291 if (i == 0 ? !use_alpha : !use_color)
2292 continue;
2293 const auto reg = m_shadow.find(VertexBase + slot * VertexStride + i * 4);
2294 if (reg == m_shadow.end())
2295 {
2296 return TrianglePreparation::Rejected;
2297 }
2298 float input;
2299 std::memcpy(&input, &reg->second, sizeof(input));
2300 if (!std::isfinite(input) || (i == 0 && (input < 0 || input > 256)))
2301 {
2302 return TrianglePreparation::Rejected;
2303 }
2304 flat_color[i] = i ? std::clamp(double(input), 0.0, textured ? 256.0 : 255.0) : input / 256.0;
2305 }
2306 }
2307 auto edge = [](const Vertex& a, const Vertex& b, double x, double y) {
2308 return (b.x - a.x) * (y - a.y) - (b.y - a.y) * (x - a.x);
2309 };
2310 double area = edge(vertex[0], vertex[1], vertex[2].x, vertex[2].y);
2311 if (!area)
2312 return TrianglePreparation::NoOp;
2313 if (area < 0)
2314 {
2315 std::swap(vertex[1], vertex[2]);
2316 area = -area;
2317 }
2318 const Vertex &a = vertex[0], &b = vertex[1], &c = vertex[2];
2319 const int left = std::max(int(peek(ClipXMin) >> 4),
2320 int(std::ceil(std::min({a.x, b.x, c.x}) - 0.5))),
2321 top = std::max(int(peek(ClipYMin) >> 4),
2322 int(std::ceil(std::min({a.y, b.y, c.y}) - 0.5))),
2323 right = std::min({int(m_color_width) - 1, int(peek(ClipXMax) >> 4),
2324 int(std::floor(std::max({a.x, b.x, c.x}) - 0.5))}),
2325 bottom = std::min({int(m_color_height) - 1, int(peek(ClipYMax) >> 4),
2326 int(std::floor(std::max({a.y, b.y, c.y}) - 0.5))});
2327 if (left > right || top > bottom)
2328 return TrianglePreparation::NoOp;
2329 auto top_left = [](const Vertex& p, const Vertex& q) {
2330 return q.y < p.y || (q.y == p.y && q.x > p.x);
2331 };
2332 const bool include_a = top_left(b, c), include_b = top_left(c, a), include_c = top_left(a, b);
2333 const uint32_t wid = (peek(DrawControl) >> 4) & 0xf000;
2334 const bool depth_less = plane_value(2, 5, 0) == 0x0a000207;
2335 const uint32_t texture_profile = peek(PipelineControl0),
2336 texture_base = textured ? texture_offset(peek(TextureBase)) : 0,
2337 texture_width = 1u << ((texture_profile >> 8) & 15),
2338 texture_height = 1u << ((texture_profile >> 4) & 15);
2339 const unsigned texture_row_shift = m_texture.size() == MaxTextureSize ? 14 : 13;
2340 operation = {};
2341 std::copy(std::begin(vertex), std::end(vertex), std::begin(operation.vertex));
2342 std::copy(std::begin(flat_color), std::end(flat_color), std::begin(operation.flat_color));
2343 operation.area = area;
2344 operation.left = left;
2345 operation.top = top;
2346 operation.right = right;
2347 operation.bottom = bottom;
2348 operation.textured = textured;
2349 operation.flat = flat;
2350 operation.blend = blend;
2351 operation.blend_control = peek(PipelineControl2);
2352 operation.no_depth = no_depth;
2353 operation.affine = affine;
2354 operation.depth_less = depth_less;
2355 operation.wid = wid;
2356 operation.bank = bank;
2357 operation.color_width = m_color_width;
2358 operation.color_rop = color_rop;
2359 operation.color_offset = size_t(bank) * m_color_pixels;
2360 operation.texture_base = texture_base;
2361 operation.texture_width = texture_width;
2362 operation.texture_height = texture_height;
2363 operation.texture_row_shift = texture_row_shift;
2364 operation.texture_alpha = texture_alpha;
2365 operation.texture_format = pipeline & 0x0f007000u;
2366 operation.texture_mode = texture_mode;
2367 operation.texture_environment = peek(PipelineControl5);
2368 operation.texture_clamp = pipeline & 0x0c;
2369 operation.texture_border = peek(PipelineControl1);
2370 operation.row_edges[0] = {1, 2, c.y == b.y ? 0 : (c.x - b.x) / (c.y - b.y), include_a};
2371 operation.row_edges[1] = {2, 0, a.y == c.y ? 0 : (a.x - c.x) / (a.y - c.y), include_b};
2372 operation.row_edges[2] = {0, 1, b.y == a.y ? 0 : (b.x - a.x) / (b.y - a.y), include_c};

2687
2688void CRealImage2100::triangle_command(uint32_t address, uint32_t value)
2689{
2690 TriangleOperation operation;
2691 const TrianglePreparation result = prepare_triangle(address, value, operation);
2692 if (result == TrianglePreparation::Rejected)
2693 unimplemented_once("REALimage triangle command/profile (command rejected)",
2694 address, value, true);
2695 else if (result == TrianglePreparation::Ready)
2696 execute_triangle(operation);
2697}
2698
2699void CRealImage2100::execute_triangle(const TriangleOperation& operation)
2700{
2701 using Vertex = TriangleOperation::Vertex;

2703 const Vertex &a = vertex[0], &b = vertex[1], &c = vertex[2];
2704 const double area = operation.area;
2705 const double* const flat_color = operation.flat_color;
2706 const int left = operation.left, top = operation.top,
2707 right = operation.right, bottom = operation.bottom;
2708 const bool textured = operation.textured, flat = operation.flat,
2709 blend = operation.blend, no_depth = operation.no_depth, depth_less = operation.depth_less,
2710 affine = operation.affine, texture_alpha = operation.texture_alpha,
2711 simple_texture = textured && operation.texture_format == 0x0a002000u && operation.texture_mode == 0 &&
2712 !affine && !blend && no_depth && !operation.texture_clamp,
2713 include_a = operation.row_edges[0].inclusive,
2714 include_b = operation.row_edges[1].inclusive,
2715 include_c = operation.row_edges[2].inclusive;
2716 const uint32_t wid = operation.wid, bank = operation.bank,
2717 texture_base = operation.texture_base, texture_width = operation.texture_width,
2718 texture_height = operation.texture_height;
2719 const unsigned texture_row_shift = operation.texture_row_shift;

2721 const bool additive = operation.color_rop == 0x10101010u || operation.color_rop == 0xb0b0b0b0u,
2722 inverse_destination = (operation.blend_control & 0x80) != 0;

2725 df = additive ? 1.0 : inverse_destination ? 1 - alpha : alpha;

2728 auto edge = [](const Vertex& p, const Vertex& q, double x, double y) {
2729 return (q.x - p.x) * (y - p.y) - (q.y - p.y) * (x - p.x);

2732 uint32_t* const color_plane = m_color.data() + operation.color_offset;

2734#if defined(__AVX2__) && defined(REALIMAGE_SSE2)

2751 sample_row_shift = 0;

2759 span_right = right;

2830 for (unsigned lane = 0; lane < 4; ++lane)
2831 if ((active & (1u << lane)) && (m_auxiliary[offset + lane] & 0xf000) != wid)
2832 active &= ~(1u << lane);
2833
2834 if (!active)
2835 return Group{zero, zero, 0};
