2837 wa = _mm256_div_pd(_mm256_div_pd(ea, area2), _mm256_set1_pd(a.z)),
2838 tb = _mm256_div_pd(wb, _mm256_set1_pd(b.z)), tc = _mm256_div_pd(wc, _mm256_set1_pd(c.z));
2839 const __m256d mask = _mm256_castsi256_pd(_mm256_set_epi64x(active & 8 ? -1ll : 0, active & 4 ? -1ll : 0, active & 2 ? -1ll : 0, active & 1 ? -1ll : 0));
2840 const __m256d denominator = _mm256_or_pd(_mm256_and_pd(mask, _mm256_add_pd(_mm256_add_pd(wa, tb), tc)),
2841 _mm256_andnot_pd(mask, _mm256_set1_pd(1)));
2842 const __m256d s = _mm256_div_pd(_mm256_add_pd(_mm256_add_pd(_mm256_mul_pd(wa, _mm256_set1_pd(a.s)),
2843 _mm256_mul_pd(tb, _mm256_set1_pd(b.s))), _mm256_mul_pd(tc, _mm256_set1_pd(c.s))), denominator),
2844 t = _mm256_div_pd(_mm256_add_pd(_mm256_add_pd(_mm256_mul_pd(wa, _mm256_set1_pd(a.t)),
2845 _mm256_mul_pd(tb, _mm256_set1_pd(b.t))), _mm256_mul_pd(tc, _mm256_set1_pd(c.t))), denominator);
2846 return Group{s, t, active};
2847 };
2848 struct Packet
2849 {
2850 __m256d s0, t0, s1, t1;
2851 unsigned active;
2852 };
2853 // Stage coordinates to reduce register pressure while sampling.
2854 Packet packets[16];
2855 for (int begin = span_left; begin <= span_right; begin += 128)
2856 {
2857 const unsigned count = unsigned(std::min(16, (span_right - begin) / 8 + 1));
2858 for (unsigned i = 0; i < count; ++i)
2859 {
2860 const int x = begin + int(i) * 8;
2861 const auto low = prepare_group(x), high = prepare_group(x + 4);
2862 packets[i] = {low.s, low.t, high.s, high.t, low.active | (high.active << 4)};
2863 }
2864 for (unsigned i = 0; i < count; ++i)
2865 {
2866 const int x = begin + int(i) * 8;
2867 const Packet& packet = packets[i];
2868 const unsigned active = packet.active;
2869 if (!active)
2870 continue;
2871 const __m256i color = realimage_texture8(packet.s0, packet.t0, packet.s1, packet.t1, sample_texture,
2872 sample_base, texture_width, texture_height, sample_row_shift);
2873 const size_t offset = size_t(y) * operation.color_width + unsigned(x);
2874 if (active == 255)
2875 {
2876 const __m256i old_color = _mm256_loadu_si256(reinterpret_cast<const __m256i*>(color_plane + offset));
2877 _mm256_storeu_si256(reinterpret_cast<__m256i*>(color_plane + offset),
2878 _mm256_or_si256(_mm256_and_si256(old_color, _mm256_set1_epi32(0xff000000u)), color));
2879 }
2880 else
2881 {
2882 const __m256i lane_mask = _mm256_set_epi32(active & 128 ? -1 : 0, active & 64 ? -1 : 0,
2883 active & 32 ? -1 : 0, active & 16 ? -1 : 0, active & 8 ? -1 : 0, active & 4 ? -1 : 0,
2884 active & 2 ? -1 : 0, active & 1 ? -1 : 0);

2886 _mm256_maskstore_epi32(reinterpret_cast<int*>(color_plane + offset), lane_mask,
2887 _mm256_or_si256(_mm256_and_si256(old_color, _mm256_set1_epi32(0xff000000u)), color));

2891 }
2892 return;
2893 }

2896 {
2897 const __m128d zero = _mm_setzero_pd(), area2 = _mm_set1_pd(area);
2898 auto vector_edge = [&] (const Vertex& p, const Vertex& q, __m128d xx, __m128d yy) {
2899 return _mm_sub_pd(_mm_mul_pd(_mm_set1_pd(q.x - p.x), _mm_sub_pd(yy, _mm_set1_pd(p.y))),
2900 _mm_mul_pd(_mm_set1_pd(q.y - p.y), _mm_sub_pd(xx, _mm_set1_pd(p.x))));

2904 };
2905 for (int y = top; y <= bottom; ++y)
2906 {
2907 int span_left, span_right;
2908 row_span(y, span_left, span_right);
2909 struct Pair
2910 {
2911 __m128d s, t;

2913 };
2914 auto prepare_pair = [&](int x) {

2916 const __m128d ea = vector_edge(b, c, xx, yy), eb = vector_edge(c, a, xx, yy), ec = vector_edge(a, b, xx, yy);

2918 _mm_and_pd(inside(eb, include_b), inside(ec, include_c))))) & (x > span_right ? 0u : x < span_right ? 3u : 1u);

2922 if ((active & 2) && (m_auxiliary[offset + 1] & 0xf000) != wid)

2926 wa = _mm_div_pd(_mm_div_pd(ea, area2), _mm_set1_pd(a.z)),
2927 tb = _mm_div_pd(wb, _mm_set1_pd(b.z)), tc = _mm_div_pd(wc, _mm_set1_pd(c.z));

2933 t = _mm_div_pd(_mm_add_pd(_mm_add_pd(_mm_mul_pd(wa, _mm_set1_pd(a.t)),
2934 _mm_mul_pd(tb, _mm_set1_pd(b.t))), _mm_mul_pd(tc, _mm_set1_pd(c.t))), denominator);

2937 struct Packet
2938 {
2939 __m128d s0, t0, s1, t1;
2940 };
2941 // Stage coordinates to reduce register pressure while sampling.
2942 Packet packets[32];
2943 unsigned active_masks[32];
2944 for (int begin = span_left; begin <= span_right; begin += 128)
2945 {
2946 const unsigned count = unsigned(std::min(32, (span_right - begin) / 4 + 1));

2948 {
2949 const int x = begin + int(i) * 4;

2951 packets[i].s0 = low.s;
2952 packets[i].t0 = low.t;
2953 active_masks[i] = low.active;

2955 packets[i].s1 = high.s;
2956 packets[i].t1 = high.t;
2957 active_masks[i] |= high.active << 2;
2958 }
2959 for (unsigned i = 0; i < count; ++i)
2960 {
2961 const int x = begin + int(i) * 4;
2962 const Packet& packet = packets[i];
2963 const unsigned active = active_masks[i];
2964 if (!active)
2965 continue;

2967 texture_base, texture_width, texture_height, texture_row_shift);

2969 if (active == 15)
2970 {
2971 const __m128i old_color = _mm_loadu_si128(reinterpret_cast<const __m128i*>(color_plane + offset));
2972 _mm_storeu_si128(reinterpret_cast<__m128i*>(color_plane + offset),
2973 _mm_or_si128(_mm_and_si128(old_color, _mm_set1_epi32(0xff000000u)), color));

2975 else
2976 {

2989 // Launches reuse all three slots; sorting must leave their registers intact.
2990 for (int y = top; y <= bottom; ++y)
2991 {
2992 int span_left, span_right;
2993 row_span(y, span_left, span_right);
2994 for (int x = span_left; x <= span_right; ++x)
2995 {
2996 const double ea = edge(b, c, x + 0.5, y + 0.5),
2997 eb = edge(c, a, x + 0.5, y + 0.5), ec = edge(a, b, x + 0.5, y + 0.5);
2998 if (ea < 0 || (ea == 0 && !include_a) ||
2999 eb < 0 || (eb == 0 && !include_b) || ec < 0 || (ec == 0 && !include_c))
3000 continue;
3001 const size_t offset = size_t(y) * operation.color_width + unsigned(x);
3002 uint32_t& auxiliary = m_auxiliary[offset];
3003 if ((auxiliary & 0xf000) != wid)
3004 continue;
3005 uint32_t& destination = color_plane[offset];
3006 const double wb = eb / area, wc = ec / area;
3007 if (!no_depth)
3008 {
3009 const uint32_t z = uint32_t(std::clamp(a.z + wb * (b.z - a.z) + wc * (c.z - a.z),
3010 0.0, 1.0) * 16777215),
3011 old_z = (auxiliary & 0xfff) | ((auxiliary >> 4) & 0xfff000);
3012 if (z > old_z || (depth_less && z == old_z))
3013 continue;
3014 auxiliary = (auxiliary & ~0x0fff0fffu) | (z & 0xfff) | ((z & 0xfff000) << 4);
3015 }
3016 if (textured)
3017 {
3018 double s, t;
3019 if (affine)
3020 {
3021 s = a.s + wb * (b.s - a.s) + wc * (c.s - a.s);
3022 t = a.t + wb * (b.t - a.t) + wc * (c.t - a.t);
3023 }
3024 else
3025 {
3026 const double wa = ea / area / a.z, tb = wb / b.z, tc = wc / c.z,
3027 denominator = wa + tb + tc;
3028 s = (wa * a.s + tb * b.s + tc * c.s) / denominator;
3029 t = (wa * a.t + tb * b.t + tc * c.t) / denominator;
3030 }
3031 if (simple_texture)
3032 {
3033 const uint32_t color = texture_color(s, t, texture_base,
3034 texture_width, texture_height, texture_row_shift);
3035 destination = (destination & 0xff000000u) | color;
3036 continue;
3037 }
3038 const auto texel = texture_sample(s, t, texture_base,
3039 texture_width, texture_height, texture_row_shift, operation.texture_format,
3040 operation.texture_clamp, operation.texture_border);
3041 auto primary = [&](double av, double bv, double cv, unsigned i) {
3042 return flat ? flat_color[i] / (i ? 256.0 : 1.0) :
3043 std::clamp(av + wb * (bv - av) + wc * (cv - av), 0.0, 256.0) / 256.0;
3044 };
3045 double alpha = primary(a.alpha, b.alpha, c.alpha, 0);
3046 if (texture_alpha && operation.texture_mode != 0)
3047 alpha = operation.texture_mode == 0x18000 ? texel[0] : alpha * texel[0];
3048 auto channel = [&](double av, double bv, double cv, unsigned i) {
3049 const unsigned shift = (3 - i) * 8;
3050 const double fragment = primary(av, bv, cv, i), texture = texel[i];
3051 double source;
3052 switch (operation.texture_mode)
3053 {
3054 case 0:
3055 source = texture_alpha ? fragment * (1 - texel[0]) + texture * texel[0] : texture;
3056 break;
3057 case 0x8000:
3058 source = fragment * texture;
3059 break;
3060 case 0x10000:
3061 source = fragment * (1 - texture) +
3062 ((operation.texture_environment >> shift) & 255) / 255.0 * texture;
3063 break;
3064 default:
3065 source = texture;
3066 break;
3067 }
3068 const double result = blend ? blend_channel(source * 255, alpha,
3069 (destination >> shift) & 255) : source * 255;
3070 return uint32_t(std::clamp(result, 0.0, 255.0));
3071 };
3072 const uint32_t color = (channel(a.red, b.red, c.red, 1) << 16) |
3073 (channel(a.green, b.green, c.green, 2) << 8) | channel(a.blue, b.blue, c.blue, 3);
3074 destination = (destination & 0xff000000u) | color;
3075 continue;
3076 }
3077 if (flat)
3078 {
3079 uint32_t color = 0;
3080 for (unsigned i = 1; i < 4; ++i)
3081 {
3082 const unsigned shift = (3 - i) * 8;
3083 const double channel = blend ? blend_channel(flat_color[i], flat_color[0],
3084 (destination >> shift) & 255) : flat_color[i];
3085 color |= uint32_t(channel) << shift;
3086 }
3087 destination = (destination & 0xff000000u) | color;
3088 continue;
3089 }
3090 const double alpha = blend ? std::clamp(a.alpha + wb * (b.alpha - a.alpha) +
3091 wc * (c.alpha - a.alpha), 0.0, 256.0) / 256.0 : 1.0;
3092 auto channel = [&](double av, double bv, double cv, unsigned shift) {
3093 const double source = std::clamp(av + wb * (bv - av) + wc * (cv - av), 0.0, 255.0);
3094 return uint32_t(blend ? blend_channel(source, alpha, (destination >> shift) & 255) : source);
3095 };
3096 const uint32_t color = (channel(a.red, b.red, c.red, 16) << 16) |
3097 (channel(a.green, b.green, c.green, 8) << 8) | channel(a.blue, b.blue, c.blue, 0);
3098 destination = (destination & 0xff000000u) | color;
3099 }
3100 }
3101}
3102
3103// RGB565, linear/repeat sampling, RGB decal mode.
3104uint32_t CRealImage2100::texture_color(double s, double t, uint32_t base,
3105 uint32_t width, uint32_t height, unsigned row_shift) const
3106{
3107 const double u = realimage_repeat_fraction(s) * width - 0.5,
3108 v = realimage_repeat_fraction(t) * height - 0.5;
3109 const int x = int(std::floor(u)), y = int(std::floor(v));
3110 const double fx = u - x, fy = v - y;
3111 auto texel = [&](int tx, int ty) {
3112 const uint32_t offset = base + ((uint32_t(ty) & (height - 1)) << row_shift) +
3113 ((uint32_t(tx) & (width - 1)) << 1);
3114 return uint32_t(m_texture[offset]) | (uint32_t(m_texture[offset + 1]) << 8);
3115 };
3116 const uint32_t pixels[] = {texel(x, y), texel(x + 1, y), texel(x, y + 1), texel(x + 1, y + 1)};
3117 auto channel = [&](unsigned shift, uint32_t mask) {
3118 const double a = (pixels[0] >> shift) & mask, b = (pixels[1] >> shift) & mask,
3119 c = (pixels[2] >> shift) & mask, d = (pixels[3] >> shift) & mask;
3120 const double top = a + fx * (b - a), bottom = c + fx * (d - c);
3121 return uint32_t(std::clamp((top + fy * (bottom - top)) * 255 / mask, 0.0, 255.0));
3122 };
3123 return (channel(11, 31) << 16) | (channel(5, 63) << 8) | channel(0, 31);
3124}
3125
3126std::array<double, 4> CRealImage2100::texture_sample(double s, double t, uint32_t base,
3127 uint32_t width, uint32_t height, unsigned row_shift, uint32_t format,
3128 uint32_t clamp, uint32_t border) const
3129{
3130 const bool clamp_s = (clamp & 8) != 0, clamp_t = (clamp & 4) != 0,
3131 rgba = (format & 0x7000) == 0x3000, wide = (format & 0x0f000000u) == 0x0d000000u;
3132 const double u = (clamp_s ? std::clamp(s, 0.0, 1.0) : realimage_repeat_fraction(s)) * width - 0.5,
3133 v = (clamp_t ? std::clamp(t, 0.0, 1.0) : realimage_repeat_fraction(t)) * height - 0.5;
3134 const int x = int(std::floor(u)), y = int(std::floor(v));
3135 const double fx = u - x, fy = v - y;
3136 auto texel = [&](int tx, int ty) {
3137 // GL_CLAMP blends edge samples with the packed constant border.
3138 if ((clamp_s && (tx < 0 || tx >= int(width))) || (clamp_t && (ty < 0 || ty >= int(height))))
3139 return border;
3140 const uint32_t offset = base + ((uint32_t(ty) & (height - 1)) << row_shift) +
3141 ((uint32_t(tx) & (width - 1)) << (wide ? 2 : 1));
3142 uint32_t value = uint32_t(m_texture[offset]) | (uint32_t(m_texture[offset + 1]) << 8);
3143 if (wide)
3144 value |= (uint32_t(m_texture[offset + 2]) << 16) | (uint32_t(m_texture[offset + 3]) << 24);
3145 return value;
3146 };
3147 const uint32_t pixels[] = {texel(x, y), texel(x + 1, y), texel(x, y + 1), texel(x + 1, y + 1)};
3148 auto channel = [&](unsigned shift, uint32_t mask) {
3149 const double a = (pixels[0] >> shift) & mask, b = (pixels[1] >> shift) & mask,
3150 c = (pixels[2] >> shift) & mask, d = (pixels[3] >> shift) & mask;
3151 const double top = a + fx * (b - a), bottom = c + fx * (d - c);
3152 return (top + fy * (bottom - top)) / mask;
3153 };
3154 if (wide)
3155 return {rgba ? channel(24, 255) : 1, channel(16, 255), channel(8, 255), channel(0, 255)};
3156 return rgba ? std::array<double, 4>{channel(12, 15), channel(8, 15), channel(4, 15), channel(0, 15)} :
3157 std::array<double, 4>{1, channel(11, 31), channel(5, 63), channel(0, 31)};
3158}
3159
3160void CRealImage2100::host_data(uint32_t v)
3161{
3162 if (!m_pending.width)
3163 {
3164 unimplemented_once("REALimage host data without upload", HostData, v, true);
3165 return;
3166 }
3167 const int32_t x = int16_t(m_pending.x) +
3168 int32_t(m_pending.word % m_pending.width);
3169 const int32_t y = int16_t(m_pending.y) +
3170 int32_t(m_pending.word / m_pending.width);
3171 // Masked-out pixels still consume their host-data word.
3172 if (!m_pending.auxiliary_compare_mask ||
3173 (uint32_t(x) < m_color_width && uint32_t(y) < m_color_height &&
3174 !((m_auxiliary[size_t(y) * m_color_width + x] ^ m_pending.auxiliary_reference) &
3175 m_pending.auxiliary_compare_mask)))
3176 execute_pixel(prepare_pixel(uint32_t(x), uint32_t(y), v, m_pending.banks));
3177 if (++m_pending.word == uint64_t(m_pending.width) * m_pending.height)
3178 m_pending = {};
3179}
3180
3181uint32_t CRealImage2100::host_read()
3182{
3183 // Readback returns RGB directly, without destination ROP or write masks.
3184 const uint32_t value = readback_pixel(m_readback.word);
3185 if (++m_readback.word == m_readback.width * m_readback.height)
3186 m_readback = {};
3187 return value;
3188}
3189
3190uint32_t CRealImage2100::readback_pixel(uint32_t word) const
3191{
3192 const uint32_t bank = m_readback.banks == 2 ? 1 : 0,
3193 x = m_readback.x + word % m_readback.width,
3194 y = m_readback.y + word / m_readback.width;
3195 return m_color[size_t(bank) * m_color_pixels + y * m_color_width + x];
3196}
3197
3198void CRealImage2100::update_irq()
3199{
3200 // OpenVMS enables DMA notifications with 7 and masks them with 0 or 1.
3201 const bool level = m_dma_irq_pending && m_dma_regs[1] == 7;
3202 if (level == m_irq)
3203 return;
3204 m_irq = level;
3205 if (m_irq_callback)
3206 m_irq_callback(level);
3207}
3208
3209void CRealImage2100::dma_completed()
3210{
3211 m_dma_irq_pending = true;
3212 update_irq();
3213}
3214
3215bool CRealImage2100::dma_setup_supported(uint32_t v) const
3216{
3217 if ((m_dma_regs[0] & ~0x200u) ||
3218 (m_dma_regs[1] != 0 && m_dma_regs[1] != 1 && m_dma_regs[1] != 7) ||
3219 (m_dma_regs[13] && (m_dma_regs[13] != 0xffffe000u ||
3220 ((v & ~DMACommandListCountMask) != 0xc0000000u &&
3221 (v & 0xffff0000u) != 0xc4800000u))) || m_dma_regs[14] != 8)
3222 return false;
3223 for (unsigned i : {2u, 3u, 4u, 5u, 6u, 10u, 15u, 16u, 17u, 18u})
3224 if (m_dma_regs[i])
3225 return false;
3226 return true;
3227}
3228
3229void CRealImage2100::dma_command(uint32_t v)
3230{
3231 const uint32_t mode = v & ~DMACommandListCountMask;
3232 if (mode == 0xa1800000u || mode == 0xc0800000u)
3233 {
3234 dma_texture_upload(v);
3235 return;
3236 }
3237 if (mode == 0xc0000000u || mode == 0xc0400000u || mode == 0xa1000000u)
3238 {
3239 dma_command_list(v);
3240 return;
3241 }
3242 // Emulator staging limit, independent of driver buffer allocation.
3243 constexpr uint32_t DMABufferSize = 32768;
3244 const uint32_t destination = m_dma_regs[8], source = m_dma_regs[9],
3245 completion = m_dma_regs[12], words = v & 0xffff, bytes = words * 4;
3246 if ((v & 0xffff0000u) != 0xc4800000u || !words || bytes > DMABufferSize ||
3247 !dma_setup_supported(v) ||
3248 !m_readback.width ||
3249 uint64_t(m_readback.width) * m_readback.height - m_readback.word < words ||
3250 ((destination | source | completion) & 3) ||
3251 source < HostData || source > HostData + HostReadSize - bytes ||
3252 uint64_t(destination) + bytes > 0x100000000ull ||
3253 uint64_t(completion) + 4 > 0x100000000ull ||
3254 (uint64_t(completion) < uint64_t(destination) + bytes &&
3255 uint64_t(completion) + 4 > destination))
3256 {
3257 unimplemented(
3258 "REALimage DMA transfer (rejected; completion not written)", DMACommand, v, true);
3259 return;
3260 }
3261 std::array<uint8_t, DMABufferSize> data{};
3262 for (uint32_t word = 0; word < words; ++word)
3263 {
3264 const uint32_t pixel = readback_pixel(m_readback.word + word);
3265 for (unsigned lane = 0; lane < 4; ++lane)
3266 data[word * 4 + lane] = uint8_t(pixel >> (lane * 8));
3267 }
3268 // Commit FIFO progress only after payload and completion writes succeed.
3269 if (!m_dma_writer || !m_dma_writer(destination, data.data(), bytes, completion))
3270 {
3271 report("DMA_WRITE", destination, bytes, "PCI DMA write unavailable or rejected");
3272 return;
3273 }
3274 m_readback.word += words;
3275 if (m_readback.word == m_readback.width * m_readback.height)
3276 m_readback = {};
3277 dma_completed();
3278}
3279
3280void CRealImage2100::dma_texture_upload(uint32_t v)
3281{
3282 const uint32_t completion = m_dma_regs[12];
3283 auto reject = [&]() {
3284 unimplemented("REALimage DMA texture upload (rejected; completion not written)",
3285 DMACommand, v, true);
3286 };
3287 auto source_range = [&](uint32_t address, uint32_t bytes) {
3288 return !((address | bytes) & 3) &&
3289 uint64_t(address) + bytes <= 0x100000000ull &&
3290 !(uint64_t(completion) < uint64_t(address) + bytes &&
3291 uint64_t(completion) + 4 > address);
3292 };
3293 if (!dma_setup_supported(v) || m_dma_list_active || (completion & 3))
3294 {
3295 reject();
3296 return;
3297 }
3298 if (!m_dma_reader || !m_dma_completer)
3299 {
3300 report("DMA_READ", m_dma_regs[8], v, "PCI DMA upload callbacks unavailable");
3301 return;
3302 }
3303 // Stage the chain so a bad link cannot leave a partial upload.
3304 auto texture = m_texture;
3305 std::set<uint32_t> visited;
3306 uint32_t command = v, source = m_dma_regs[8], target = m_dma_regs[9],
3307 next = m_dma_regs[11];
3308 for (;;)
3309 {
3310 const uint32_t mode = command & ~DMACommandListCountMask,
3311 bytes = (command & DMACommandListCountMask) * 4;
3312 if ((mode != 0xa1800000u && mode != 0xc0800000u) || !bytes ||
3313 !source_range(source, bytes) || (target & 3) || target < 0x04000000u ||
3314 uint64_t(target) + bytes > 0x04000000ull + MaxTextureSize ||
3315 (mode == 0xa1800000u &&
3316 (!source_range(next, 16) || !visited.insert(next).second)))
3317 {
3318 reject();
3319 return;
3320 }
3321 std::vector<uint8_t> data(bytes);
3322 if (!m_dma_reader(source, data.data(), bytes, completion))
3323 {
3324 report("DMA_READ", source, bytes, "PCI DMA texture data unavailable or rejected");
3325 return;
3326 }
3327 for (uint32_t i = 0; i < bytes; i += 4)
3328 {
3329 const uint32_t offset = texture_offset(target - 0x04000000u + i);
3330 if (offset != 0xffffffffu)
3331 std::copy_n(data.data() + i, 4, texture.data() + offset);
3332 }
3333 if (mode == 0xc0800000u)
3334 break;
3335 std::array<uint8_t, 16> descriptor{};
3336 if (!m_dma_reader(next, descriptor.data(), descriptor.size(), completion))
3337 {
3338 report("DMA_READ", next, uint32_t(descriptor.size()),
3339 "PCI DMA descriptor unavailable or rejected");
3340 return;
3341 }
3342 auto word = [&](unsigned i) {
3343 const uint8_t* p = descriptor.data() + i * 4;
3344 return uint32_t(p[0]) | (uint32_t(p[1]) << 8) |
3345 (uint32_t(p[2]) << 16) | (uint32_t(p[3]) << 24);
3346 };
3347 command = word(0);
3348 source = word(1);
3349 target = word(2);
3350 next = word(3);
3351 }
3352 m_texture.swap(texture);
3353 if (!m_dma_completer(completion))
3354 report("DMA_COMPLETE", completion, v, "PCI DMA completion unavailable or rejected");
3355 else
3356 dma_completed();
3357}
3358
3359static bool dma_board_update(uint32_t address)
3360{
3361 return address == CRealImage2100::BoardIO + 1 ||
3362 address == CRealImage2100::WindowMask + 2;
3363}
3364
3365bool CRealImage2100::dma_list_target(uint32_t a) const
3366{
3367 if (dma_board_update(a))
3368 return true;
3369 if (a & 3)
3370 return false;
3371 if (vertex_register(a) || integer_vertex_register(a) ||
3372 a == ContextLink || zero_context_register(a))
3373 return true;
3374 if (a >= HostData && a < HostData + HostDataSize)
3375 return true;
3376 if (a >= 0x01000000 && a < 0x03000000)
3377 return ((a & 0x1fff) >> 2) < m_color_width &&
3378 ((a & 0x00ffffff) >> 13) < m_color_height;
3379 const int plane_index = plane_register(a);
3380 if (plane_index >= 0)
3381 {
3382 const uint32_t available = m_color_width == MaxColorWidth ? 255u : 15u;
3383 return plane_index < 16 || plane_index > 24 ||
3384 a == PlanePixelMask || (a & ~0x1fu) == PlaneClearColor ||
3385 !(((a >> 13) & 255) & ~available);
3386 }
3387 // Other command-list targets use the existing register handlers.
3388 switch (a)
3389 {
3390 case Status: case UnitReset:
3391 case BoardIO: case WindowMask:
3392 case ClipXMax: case ClipYMax: case ClipXMin: case ClipYMin:
3393 case GlobalControl0: case GlobalControl1: case GlobalControl2:
3394 case TextureBase:
3395 case PipelineControl0: case PipelineControl1:
3396 case PipelineControl2: case PipelineControl3:
3397 case PipelineControl4: case PipelineControl5:
3398 case DrawControl: case Foreground: case Background:
3399 case MonoPattern0: case MonoPattern1: case MonoPattern2: case MonoPattern3:
3400 case HostOrigin: case HostExtent: case HostCommand:
3401 case FillOrigin: case FillExtent: case FillCommand:
3402 case BitmapForeground: case BitmapBackground: case BitmapPattern0: case BitmapPattern1:
3403 case BitmapOrigin: case BitmapExtent: case BitmapCommand:
3404 case BlockSource: case BlockDestination: case BlockExtent: case BlockCommand:
3405 return true;
3406 default:
3407 return false;
3408 }
3409}
3410
3411void CRealImage2100::dma_command_list(uint32_t v)
3412{
3413 DMAListOperation operation;
3414 if (prepare_dma_list(v, operation))
3415 execute_dma_list(operation);
3416}
3417
3418bool CRealImage2100::prepare_dma_list(uint32_t v, DMAListOperation& operation)
3419{
3420 operation = {};
3421 operation.command = v;
3422 operation.completion = m_dma_regs[12];
3423 const uint32_t completion = operation.completion;
3424 uint32_t command = v, source = m_dma_regs[8], initial_address = m_dma_regs[9],
3425 next = m_dma_regs[11];
3426 auto reject = [&]() {
3427 unimplemented("REALimage DMA command list (rejected; completion not written)",
3428 DMACommand, v, true);
3429 };
3430 auto source_range = [&](uint32_t address, uint32_t bytes) {
3431 return !((address | bytes) & 3) &&
3432 uint64_t(address) + bytes <= 0x100000000ull &&
3433 !(uint64_t(completion) < uint64_t(address) + bytes &&
3434 uint64_t(completion) + 4 > address);
3435 };
3436 if (m_dma_list_active || !dma_setup_supported(v) || (completion & 3))
3437 {
3438 reject();
3439 return false;
3440 }
3441 if (!m_dma_reader || !m_dma_completer)
3442 {
3443 report("DMA_READ", source, v, "PCI DMA command-list callbacks unavailable");
3444 return false;
3445 }
3446 auto decode_word = [](const uint8_t* p) {
3447 return uint32_t(p[0]) | (uint32_t(p[1]) << 8) |
3448 (uint32_t(p[2]) << 16) | (uint32_t(p[3]) << 24);
3449 };
3450 auto& data = operation.data;
3451 auto word_at = [&](uint32_t index) {
3452 return decode_word(data.data() + size_t(index) * 4);
3453 };
3454 auto& packets = operation.packets;
3455 std::set<uint32_t> visited;
3456 // Preflight every link within the existing staging budget before executing.
3457 for (;;)
3458 {
3459 const uint32_t mode = command & ~DMACommandListCountMask,
3460 words = command & DMACommandListCountMask, bytes = words * 4;
3461 if ((mode != 0xc0000000u && mode != 0xc0400000u && mode != 0xa1000000u) || !words ||
3462 (mode == 0xc0000000u && !data.empty()) ||
3463 bytes > DMACommandListMaxBytes - data.size() || !source_range(source, bytes) ||
3464 ((initial_address & 3) && !dma_board_update(initial_address)) || (mode == 0xa1000000u &&
3465 (!source_range(next, 16) || !visited.insert(next).second)))
3466 {
3467 reject();
3468 return false;
3469 }
3470 const uint32_t first = uint32_t(data.size() / 4), end = first + words;
3471 data.resize(data.size() + bytes);
3472 if (!m_dma_reader(source, data.data() + size_t(first) * 4, bytes, completion))
3473 {
3474 report("DMA_READ", source, bytes, "PCI DMA read unavailable or rejected");
3475 return false;
3476 }
3477 uint32_t cursor = first, address = initial_address;
3478 while (cursor < end)
3479 {
3480 const uint32_t control = word_at(cursor++), count = control & 0xffff;
3481 if (count > end - cursor ||
3482 uint64_t(address) + uint64_t(count) * 4 > 0x100000000ull)
3483 {
3484 reject();
3485 return false;
3486 }
3487 // OpenVMS DMA board updates carry packed state and echo the read-only board ID.
3488 if (dma_board_update(address) && (mode != 0xc0000000u || count != 1 ||
3489 (address == BoardIO + 1 && (word_at(cursor) >> 24) != BoardIDPCGA3)))
3490 {
3491 report("DMA_TARGET", address, control, "Unsupported DMA board-update profile");
3492 reject();
3493 return false;
3494 }
3495 if (!dma_list_target(address))
3496 {
3497 report("DMA_TARGET", address, control, "Unsupported DMA command-list target");
3498 reject();
3499 return false;
3500 }
3501 for (uint32_t i = 0; i < count; ++i)
3502 if (!dma_list_target(address + i * 4))
3503 {
3504 report("DMA_TARGET", address + i * 4, word_at(cursor + i),
3505 "Unsupported DMA command-list target");
3506 reject();
3507 return false;
3508 }
3509 packets.push_back({address, control & 0xffff0000u, cursor, count});
3510 cursor += count;
3511 if (cursor == end)
3512 break;
3513 address = word_at(cursor++);
3514 if (cursor == end)
3515 {
3516 reject();
3517 return false;
3518 }
3519 }
3520 if (mode == 0xc0000000u || mode == 0xc0400000u)
3521 break;
3522 std::array<uint8_t, 16> descriptor{};
3523 if (!m_dma_reader(next, descriptor.data(), descriptor.size(), completion))
3524 {
3525 report("DMA_READ", next, uint32_t(descriptor.size()),
3526 "PCI DMA descriptor unavailable or rejected");
3527 return false;
3528 }
3529 command = decode_word(descriptor.data());
3530 source = decode_word(descriptor.data() + 4);
3531 initial_address = decode_word(descriptor.data() + 8);
3532 next = decode_word(descriptor.data() + 12);
3533 // Captured chains retain the latched completion address at their terminal link.
3534 if ((command & ~DMACommandListCountMask) == 0xc0400000u && next != completion)
3535 {
3536 reject();
3537 return false;
3538 }
3539 }
3540 return true;
3541}
3542
3543void CRealImage2100::execute_dma_list(const DMAListOperation& operation)
3544{
3545 const uint32_t completion = operation.completion;
3546 auto word_at = [&](uint32_t index) {
3547 const uint8_t* p = operation.data.data() + size_t(index) * 4;
3548 return uint32_t(p[0]) | (uint32_t(p[1]) << 8) |
3549 (uint32_t(p[2]) << 16) | (uint32_t(p[3]) << 24);
3550 };
3551 auto reject = [&]() {
3552 unimplemented("REALimage DMA command list (rejected; completion not written)",
3553 DMACommand, operation.command, true);
3554 };
3555 struct ActiveList
3556 {
3557 bool& active;
3558 ~ActiveList() { active = false; }
3559 } active{m_dma_list_active};
3560 m_dma_list_active = true;
3561 m_dma_list_rejected = false;
3562 for (const auto& packet : operation.packets)
3563 {
3564 if (packet.wait_mask)
3565 {
3566 bool ready = false;
3567 for (uint32_t i = 0; i < StatusFrameReads; ++i)
3568 if (!(status_read() & packet.wait_mask))
3569 {
3570 ready = true;
3571 break;
3572 }
3573 if (!ready)
3574 {
3575 report("DMA_WAIT", packet.address, packet.wait_mask,
3576 "DMA command-list status wait did not complete");
3577 return;
3578 }
3579 }
3580 for (uint32_t i = 0; i < packet.count; ++i)
3581 {
3582 const uint32_t address = packet.address + i * 4, value = word_at(packet.first + i);
3583 if (address == BoardIO + 1)
3584 {
3585 WriteMem(BoardIO, 16, uint16_t(value));
3586 WriteMem(BoardIO + 2, 8, uint8_t(value >> 16));
3587 }
3588 else if (address == WindowMask + 2)
3589 WriteMem(WindowMask, 32, value);
3590 else
3591 WriteMem(address, 32, value);
3592 if (m_dma_list_rejected)
3593 {
3594 reject();
3595 return;
3596 }
3597 }
3598 }
3599 m_dma_list_active = false;
3600 if (!m_dma_completer(completion))
3601 report("DMA_COMPLETE", completion, 0,
3602 "PCI DMA completion unavailable or rejected");
3603 else
3604 dma_completed();
3605}
3606
3607CRealImage2100::Frame CRealImage2100::scanout(std::string* error) const
3608{
3609 return scanout(Frame{}, error);
3610}
3611
3612CRealImage2100::Frame CRealImage2100::scanout(Frame frame, std::string* error) const
3613{
3614 frame = dac_frame(std::move(frame), error);
3615 if (!(m_dac_regs[0x0d] & 4))
3616 std::fill(frame.argb.begin(), frame.argb.end(), 0xff000000u);
3617 return frame;
3618}
3619
3620CRealImage2100::Frame CRealImage2100::dac_frame(Frame frame, std::string* error, bool vram_input) const
3621{
3622 auto reject = [&](const char* text) {
3623 if (error)
3624 *error = text;
3625 frame.width = frame.height = 0;
3626 frame.argb.clear();
3627 return std::move(frame);
3628 };
3629 if (error)
3630 error->clear();
3631 if (!native_display() || (m_board_io & 0x80))
3632 return reject("Native display disabled/blanked");
3633 if (!native_pixel_profile())
3634 return reject("Native pixel layout unsupported");
3635 if (!(m_dac_regs[0x0b] & 1))
3636 return reject("Native DAC disabled");
3637 // Each pixel's WID selects an RGB640 window attribute entry.
3638 std::array<bool, 16> supported_windows{};
3639 for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 16; ++i)
3640 {
3641 const uint32_t fb = 0x100 + i * 4, overlay = 0x200 + i * 4;
3642 const bool rgb = (m_dac_regs[fb] == 8 && m_dac_regs[fb + 1] == 12) ||
3643 m_dac_regs[fb] == 9;
3644 supported_windows[i] = vram_input || (rgb && !m_dac_regs[fb + 2] && !m_dac_regs[fb + 3] &&
3645 m_dac_regs[overlay] == 4 && !m_dac_regs[overlay + 1] &&
3646 !m_dac_regs[overlay + 2] &&
3647 (m_dac_regs[overlay + 3] == 0x48 || m_dac_regs[overlay + 3] == 0x44));
3648 }
3649 // Unlike VGA, vertical display is a count, not a last-line index.
3650 const uint32_t horizontal = peek(TimingBase),
3651 overflow = peek(TimingBase + 4) >> 24,
3652 vertical = peek(TimingBase + 0x10),
3653 extension = (peek(TimingBase + 0x1c) >> 16) & 255;
3654 // The captured VMS clock setup retains eight-pixel timing counts with 4:1 serialization.
3655 const bool unscaled_timing = m_color_width == MaxColorWidth &&
3656 peek(DisplaySelect) == 0x4700 && peek(BoardTiming) == 0x26c03 &&
3657 m_board_timing == 0x38 && horizontal == 0x9fce &&
3658 peek(TimingBase + 4) == 0x2814a2 && vertical == 0x301 && extension == 0x0d;
3659 const uint32_t horizontal_unit = m_dac_regs[0x08] == 0 ? 8 :
3660 m_dac_regs[0x08] == 1 && m_color_width == MaxColorWidth ?
3661 (unscaled_timing ? 8 : 16) : 0;
3662 const uint32_t width = ((((horizontal >> 8) & 255) |
3663 ((extension & 0x40) << 2)) + 1) * horizontal_unit,
3664 vertical_extension = extension & 0x3f;
3665 // Whole extension patterns are established by both drivers' mode tables.
3666 const uint32_t height = ((vertical >> 16) & 255) |
3667 ((overflow & 2) << 7) | ((overflow & 0x40) << 3) |
3668 (vertical_extension == 0x0d ? 1024u : 0u);
3669 if ((vertical_extension != 0 && vertical_extension != 8 && vertical_extension != 0x0d) ||
3670 !width || !height ||
3671 width > m_color_width || height > m_color_height)
3672 return reject("Native timing unsupported");
3673 frame.width = width;
3674 frame.height = height;
3675 frame.argb.resize(size_t(width) * height);
3676 // Board I/O bits 8..23 select the color bank for each WID.
3677 const uint32_t bank_select = (m_board_io >> 8) & 0xffff;
3678 const bool all_windows_supported = std::all_of(supported_windows.begin(),
3679 supported_windows.end(), [](bool v) { return v; });
3680 if ((bank_select == 0 || bank_select == 0xffff) && all_windows_supported)
3681 {
3682 for (uint32_t y = 0; y < height; ++y)
3683 {
3684 const uint32_t* source = m_color.data() +
3685 (bank_select ? m_color_pixels : 0) + size_t(y) * m_color_width;
3686 uint32_t* destination = frame.argb.data() + size_t(y) * width;
3687 for (uint32_t x = 0; x < width; ++x)
3688 destination[x] = 0xff000000 | source[x];
3689 }
3690 if (!vram_input)
3691 composite_cursor(frame);
3692 return frame;
3693 }
3694 if (all_windows_supported)
3695 {
3696 for (uint32_t y = 0; y < height; ++y)
3697 {
3698 const size_t row = size_t(y) * m_color_width;
3699 uint32_t* destination = frame.argb.data() + size_t(y) * width;
3700 uint32_t x = 0;
3701#if defined(REALIMAGE_SSE2)
3702 for (; x + 4 <= width; x += 4)
3703 {
3704 const __m128i wids = _mm_and_si128(_mm_srli_epi32(_mm_loadu_si128(
3705 reinterpret_cast<const __m128i*>(m_auxiliary.data() + row + x)), 12),
3706 _mm_set1_epi32(15));
3707 const unsigned wid = unsigned(_mm_cvtsi128_si32(wids));
3708 if (_mm_movemask_epi8(_mm_cmpeq_epi32(wids, _mm_set1_epi32(wid))) == 0xffff)
3709 {
3710 const uint32_t* source = m_color.data() + row + x +
3711 (((bank_select >> wid) & 1) ? m_color_pixels : 0);
3712 _mm_storeu_si128(reinterpret_cast<__m128i*>(destination + x),
3713 _mm_or_si128(_mm_loadu_si128(reinterpret_cast<const __m128i*>(source)),
3714 _mm_set1_epi32(int(0xff000000u))));
3715 }
3716 else
3717 for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
3718 {
3719 const unsigned pixel_wid = (m_auxiliary[row + x + i] >> 12) & 15;
3720 const size_t bank = (bank_select >> pixel_wid) & 1;
3721 destination[x + i] = 0xff000000 | m_color[bank * m_color_pixels + row + x + i];
3722 }
3723 }
3724#endif
3725 for (; x < width; ++x)
3726 {
3727 const unsigned wid = (m_auxiliary[row + x] >> 12) & 15;
3728 const size_t bank = (bank_select >> wid) & 1;
3729 destination[x] = 0xff000000 | m_color[bank * m_color_pixels + row + x];
3730 }
3731 }
3732 if (!vram_input)
3733 composite_cursor(frame);
3734 return frame;
3735 }
3736
3737 for (uint32_t y = 0; y < height; ++y)
3738 for (uint32_t x = 0; x < width; ++x)
3739 {
3740 const size_t offset = size_t(y) * m_color_width + x;
3741 const unsigned wid = (m_auxiliary[offset] >> 12) & 15;
3742 if (!supported_windows[wid])
3743 return reject("Native DAC window format unsupported");
3744 const size_t bank = (bank_select >> wid) & 1;
3745 frame.argb[size_t(y) * width + x] =
3746 0xff000000 | m_color[bank * m_color_pixels + offset];
3747 }
3748 if (!vram_input)
3749 composite_cursor(frame);
3750 return frame;
3751}
3752
3753void CRealImage2100::composite_cursor(Frame& frame, bool ten_bit) const
3754{
3755 // Blink-to-transparent has no effect while blinking is disabled.
3756 const unsigned control = m_dac_regs[0x4b] & ~0x10u;
3757 const bool x11 = control == 0x0b;
3758 if (control != 0x0a && !x11)
3759 return;
3760 // Position uses twelve data bits and bit 15 as the sign.
3761 const int origin_x = int(m_dac_regs[0x40] | ((m_dac_regs[0x41] & 15) << 8)) -
3762 ((m_dac_regs[0x41] & 0x80) ? 4096 : 0) - (m_dac_regs[0x44] & 63);
3763 const int origin_y = int(m_dac_regs[0x42] | ((m_dac_regs[0x43] & 15) << 8)) -
3764 ((m_dac_regs[0x43] & 0x80) ? 4096 : 0) - (m_dac_regs[0x45] & 63);
3765 uint32_t colors[2];
3766 for (unsigned i = 0; i < 2; ++i)
3767 {
3768 const unsigned address = 0x4800 + 3 * (i + 1);
3769 colors[i] = 0xff000000u | (uint32_t(m_dac_regs[address]) << 16) |
3770 (uint32_t(m_dac_regs[address + 1]) << 8) | m_dac_regs[address + 2];
3771 if (ten_bit)
3772 colors[i] = dac_rgb30(colors[i]);
3773 }
3774 for (int cy = 0; cy < 64; ++cy)
3775 {
3776 const int y = origin_y + cy;
3777 if (y < 0 || uint32_t(y) >= frame.height)
3778 continue;
3779 for (int cx = 0; cx < 64; ++cx)
3780 {
3781 const int x = origin_x + cx;
3782 if (x < 0 || uint32_t(x) >= frame.width)
3783 continue;
3784 // Low pairs come first; X11 uses bit 1 as the mask and bit 0 as the color.
3785 const unsigned code = (m_dac_regs[0x1000 + cy * 16 + cx / 4] >>
3786 (2 * (cx & 3))) & 3;
3787 uint32_t& pixel = frame.argb[size_t(y) * frame.width + unsigned(x)];
3788 if (x11 ? code >= 2 : code < 2)
3789 pixel = colors[code & 1];
3790 else if (!x11 && code == 3)
3791 pixel ^= ten_bit ? 0x20080200u : 0x00808080u;
3792 }
3793 }
3794}
3795
3796// BAR2 index/data pair: dword index at +0, width-aware data at +4.
3797uint32_t CRealImage2100::io_read(uint32_t a, int bits)
3798{
3799 if (a == 0 && bits == 32)
3800 return m_io_index;
3801 if (a == 4 && valid_width(bits))
3802 return ReadMem(m_io_index, bits);
3803 unimplemented("REALimage BAR2 port", a, 0, false);
3804 return width_mask(valid_width(bits) ? bits : 32);
3805}
3806
3807void CRealImage2100::io_write(uint32_t a, int bits, uint32_t v)
3808{
3809 if (a == 0 && bits == 32)
3810 {
3811 m_io_index = v;
3812 return;
3813 }
3814 if (a == 4 && valid_width(bits))
3815 {
3816 WriteMem(m_io_index, bits, v);
3817 return;
3818 }
3819 unimplemented("REALimage BAR2 port", a, v, true);
3820}
3821
3822uint32_t CRealImage2100::mem_read(uint32_t a, int bits)
3823{
3824 if (!valid_width(bits) || (a & (unsigned(bits) / 8 - 1)))
3825 {
3826 report("ACCESS_WIDTH", a, uint32_t(bits), "Invalid BAR1 width or alignment");
3827 return 0xffffffffu;
3828 }
3829 const uint32_t offset = texture_offset(a);
3830 if (offset == 0xffffffffu)
3831 return width_mask(bits);
3832 uint32_t value = 0;
3833 for (unsigned i = 0; i < unsigned(bits) / 8; ++i)
3834 value |= uint32_t(m_texture[offset + i]) << (i * 8);
3835 return value;
3836}
3837
3838void CRealImage2100::mem_write(uint32_t a, int bits, uint32_t v)
3839{
3840 if (!valid_width(bits) || (a & (unsigned(bits) / 8 - 1)))
3841 {
3842 report("ACCESS_WIDTH", a, v, "Invalid BAR1 width or alignment");
3843 return;
3844 }
3845 const uint32_t offset = texture_offset(a);
3846 if (offset == 0xffffffffu)
3847 return;
3848 for (unsigned i = 0; i < unsigned(bits) / 8; ++i)
3849 m_texture[offset + i] = uint8_t(v >> (i * 8));
3850}
3851
3852uint32_t CRealImage2100::texture_offset(uint32_t a) const
3853{
3854 if (a >= MaxTextureSize)
3855 return 0xffffffffu;
3856 if (m_texture.size() == MaxTextureSize)
3857 return a;
3858 // The 300 populates two of four 4 KiB tiles per aperture row.
3859 if (a & 0x2000)
3860 return 0xffffffffu;
3861 return (a & 0x1fff) | ((a >> 14) << 13);
3862}
3863
3864void CRealImage2100::configure_framebuffer(uint32_t ram_chips)
3865{
3866 if (ram_chips != 12 && ram_chips != 24)
3867 throw std::invalid_argument("Invalid REALimage framebuffer population");
3868 const uint32_t width = ram_chips == 24 ? MaxColorWidth : ColorWidth,
3869 height = ram_chips == 24 ? MaxColorHeight : ColorHeight;
3870 if (width == m_color_width && height == m_color_height)
3871 return;
3872 std::vector<uint32_t> color(size_t(width) * height * 2);
3873 std::vector<uint32_t> auxiliary(size_t(width) * height);
3874 m_color.swap(color);
3875 m_auxiliary.swap(auxiliary);
3876 m_color_width = width;
3877 m_color_height = height;
3878 m_color_pixels = width * height;
3879 m_board_straps = ram_chips == 24 ? 3 : 0;
3880 m_planes = {};
3881 m_clear_cache = {};
3882 m_pending = {};
3883 m_readback = {};
3884}
3885
3886void CRealImage2100::configure_texture_memory(uint32_t bytes)
3887{
3888 if (bytes != MinTextureSize && bytes != MaxTextureSize)
3889 throw std::invalid_argument("Invalid PowerStorm texture memory size");
3890 if (m_texture.size() != bytes)
3891 m_texture.assign(bytes, 0);
3892}

3904void CRealImage2100::reset(bool clear)
3905{
3906 // PCI configuration belongs to the board wrapper and is NOT reset here.
3907 if (clear)
3908 {
3909 std::fill(m_vga_memory.begin(), m_vga_memory.end(), uint8_t(0));
3910 std::fill(m_color.begin(), m_color.end(), uint32_t(0));
3911 std::fill(m_auxiliary.begin(), m_auxiliary.end(), uint32_t(0));
3912 std::fill(m_texture.begin(), m_texture.end(), uint8_t(0));
3913 }
3914 m_dma_regs.fill(0);
3915 m_dma_irq_pending = false;
3916 m_planes = {};
3917 m_clear_cache = {};
3918 m_pending = {};
3919 m_readback = {};
3920 m_palette.fill(0);
3921 std::fill(m_dac_regs.begin(), m_dac_regs.end(), uint8_t(0));
3922 m_dac_regs[0xff] = 0x3f;
3923 m_shadow.clear();
3924 m_warned.clear();
3925 m_aperture_warned = m_shadow_full_warned = false;
3926 // Power-on values are undocumented; the card presents VGA before POST.
3927 m_unit_reset = m_interrupt_enable = m_display_control = 0;
3928 m_vga_control = VGAControlVGA;
3929 m_status_phase = 0;
3930 m_frame_counter = 0;
3931 m_board_control = m_board_timing = 0;
3932 m_board_io = 0;
3933 m_io_index = 0;
3934 m_dac_index = 0;
3935 m_dac_component = 0;
3936 m_palette_read = m_palette_write = 0;
3937 update_irq();
3938}

3949void CRealImage2100::unimplemented(

3958void CRealImage2100::unimplemented_once(

3962 m_dma_list_rejected = true;

3967void CRealImage2100::write_ppm(std::ostream& out, const Frame& f)
3968{
3969 if (!f.width || !f.height || f.argb.size() != uint64_t(f.width) * f.height)
3970 throw std::runtime_error("Invalid PowerStorm frame");
3971 out << "P6\n" << f.width << ' ' << f.height << "\n255\n";
3972 for (const uint32_t c : f.argb)
3973 {
3974 out.put(char(c >> 16));
3975 out.put(char(c >> 8));
3976 out.put(char(c));
3977 }
3978 if (!out)
3979 throw std::runtime_error("PowerStorm frame write failed");
3980}
3981
3982// Snapshots
3983
3984static void put32(std::ostream& out, uint32_t v)
3985{
3986 for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
3987 out.put(char(v >> (8 * i)));
3988 if (!out)
3989 throw std::runtime_error("PowerStorm snapshot write failed");
3990}
3991
3992static uint32_t get32(std::istream& in)
3993{
3994 uint32_t v = 0;
3995 for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
3996 {
3997 const int b = in.get();
3998 if (b == std::char_traits<char>::eof())
3999 throw std::runtime_error("PowerStorm snapshot truncated");
4000 v |= uint32_t(uint8_t(b)) << (8 * i);
4001 }
4002 return v;
4003}
4004
4005static uint32_t crc32(const std::string& bytes)
4006{
4007 uint32_t crc = 0xffffffff;
4008 for (const unsigned char byte : bytes)
4009 {
4010 crc ^= byte;
4011 for (unsigned i = 0; i < 8; ++i)
4012 crc = (crc >> 1) ^ (0xedb88320u & (0u - (crc & 1)));
4013 }
4014 return ~crc;
4015}

4017// Selectors, latches, transfers, palette/DAC, shadow, VGA and color banks.
4018static constexpr uint32_t FixedPayload = CRealImage2100::MinStateSize - 16;
4019
4020void CRealImage2100::SaveState(std::ostream& out) const
4021{
4022 std::ostringstream p(std::ios::binary);
4023 put32(p, m_io_index);
4024 put32(p, m_dac_index);
4025 put32(p, m_palette_read);
4026 put32(p, m_palette_write);
4027 put32(p, m_unit_reset);
4028 put32(p, m_interrupt_enable);
4029 put32(p, m_vga_control);
4030 put32(p, m_display_control);
4031 put32(p, m_status_phase);
4032 put32(p, m_frame_counter);
4033 put32(p, m_board_control);
4034 put32(p, m_board_io);
4035 put32(p, m_board_timing);
4036 put32(p, m_dac_component);
4037 put32(p, m_pending.x);
4038 put32(p, m_pending.y);
4039 put32(p, m_pending.width);
4040 put32(p, m_pending.height);
4041 put32(p, m_pending.word);
4042 put32(p, m_pending.banks);
4043 put32(p, uint32_t(m_texture.size()));
4044 for (const uint32_t reg : m_dma_regs)
4045 put32(p, reg);
4046 for (const auto& plane : m_planes)
4047 {
4048 put32(p, plane.written);
4049 put32(p, plane.unknown_masks);
4050 const unsigned count = m_color_width == MaxColorWidth ?
4051 PlaneRegisterCount : LegacyPlaneRegisterCount;
4052 for (unsigned i = 0; i < count; ++i)
4053 put32(p, plane.regs[i]);
4054 }
4055 for (const auto& cache : m_clear_cache)
4056 {
4057 put32(p, cache.source);
4058 put32(p, cache.color);
4059 put32(p, cache.known);
4060 }
4061 put32(p, m_readback.x);
4062 put32(p, m_readback.y);
4063 put32(p, m_readback.width);
4064 put32(p, m_readback.height);
4065 put32(p, m_readback.word);
4066 put32(p, m_readback.banks);
4067 for (const uint32_t c : m_palette)
4068 put32(p, c);
4069 p.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(m_dac_regs.data()), DACRegisterCount);
4070 put32(p, uint32_t(m_shadow.size()));
4071 for (const auto& reg : m_shadow)
4072 {
4073 put32(p, reg.first);
4074 put32(p, reg.second);
4075 }
4076 p.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(m_vga_memory.data()), VGAMemorySize);
4077 for (const uint32_t c : m_color)
4078 put32(p, c);
4079 for (const uint32_t word : m_auxiliary)
4080 put32(p, word);
4081 p.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(m_texture.data()), m_texture.size());
4082 put32(p, m_dma_irq_pending ? 1 : 0);
4083 for (const auto& plane : m_planes)
4084 {
4085 for (const uint8_t written : plane.clear_written)
4086 put32(p, written);
4087 for (const auto& group : plane.clear_colors)
4088 for (const uint32_t value : group)
4089 put32(p, value);
4090 }
4091 for (const auto& cache : m_clear_cache)
4092 {
4093 put32(p, cache.patterned ? 1 : 0);
4094 for (const uint32_t value : cache.pattern)
4095 put32(p, value);
4096 }
4097 put32(p, m_pending.auxiliary_compare_mask);
4098 put32(p, m_pending.auxiliary_reference);
4099 const auto bytes = p.str();
4100 put32(out, 0x30324952); // RI20
4101 put32(out, m_color_width == MaxColorWidth ? 21 : 20);
4102 put32(out, uint32_t(bytes.size()));
4103 put32(out, crc32(bytes));
4104 out.write(bytes.data(), bytes.size());
4105 if (!out)
4106 throw std::runtime_error("PowerStorm snapshot write failed");
4107}
4108
4109void CRealImage2100::RestoreState(std::istream& in)
4110{
4111 const auto magic = get32(in), version = get32(in);
4112 if (magic != 0x30324952 || version < 9 || version > 21)
4113 throw std::runtime_error("Wrong REALimage snapshot version");
4114 const bool large = version == 11 || version == 13 || version == 15 || version == 17 || version == 19 || version == 21,
4115 packed_auxiliary = version >= 12;
4116 if (large != (m_color_width == MaxColorWidth))
4117 throw std::runtime_error("REALimage snapshot framebuffer mismatch");
4118 const uint32_t fixed_payload = FixedPayload + (version >= 10 ? 24 : 0) +
4119 (large ? (MaxColorPixels - ColorPixels) * 9 +
4120 PlaneCount * (PlaneRegisterCount - LegacyPlaneRegisterCount) * 4 : 0) +
4121 (packed_auxiliary ? m_color_pixels * 3 + 12 : 0) + (version >= 14 ? 4 : 0) +
4122 (version >= 18 ? PatternStateSize : 0) + (version >= 20 ? 8 : 0);
4123 const auto size = get32(in), crc = get32(in);
4124 if (size < fixed_payload || size > MaxStateSize - 16)
4125 throw std::runtime_error("Invalid REALimage snapshot length");
4126 std::string bytes(size, '\0');
4127 in.read(&bytes[0], size);
4128 if (!in || crc32(bytes) != crc)
4129 throw std::runtime_error("REALimage snapshot truncated/corrupt");
4130 std::istringstream p(bytes, std::ios::binary);
4131 const auto index = get32(p), dac = get32(p), rd = get32(p), wr = get32(p);
4132 if (dac > 65535 || rd > 255 || wr > 255)
4133 throw std::runtime_error("Invalid REALimage snapshot selectors");
4134 const auto unit_reset = get32(p), interrupt_enable = get32(p),
4135 vga_control = get32(p), display_control = get32(p),
4136 status_phase = get32(p), frame_counter = get32(p),
4137 board_control = get32(p), board_io = get32(p),
4138 board_timing = get32(p);
4139 if (status_phase >= StatusFrameReads || frame_counter > 0xffff ||
4140 board_control > 0xff || board_io > 0xffffff || board_timing > 0xff)
4141 throw std::runtime_error("Invalid REALimage status state");
4142 const uint32_t dac_component = get32(p);
4143 Pending pending;
4144 pending.x = get32(p);
4145 pending.y = get32(p);
4146 pending.width = get32(p);
4147 pending.height = get32(p);
4148 pending.word = get32(p);
4149 pending.banks = get32(p);
4150 const uint64_t words = uint64_t(pending.width) * pending.height;
4151 if (dac_component > 2 || pending.x > 65535 || pending.y > 65535 ||
4152 pending.width > 65536 || pending.height > 65536 ||
4153 (pending.width && (!pending.height || words > 0xffffffffu ||
4154 pending.word >= words || !pending.banks || (pending.banks & ~3u))) ||
4155 (!pending.width && (pending.x || pending.y || pending.height ||
4156 pending.word || pending.banks)))
4157 throw std::runtime_error("Invalid REALimage native transfer state");
4158 const uint32_t texture_size = get32(p);
4159 if (texture_size != MinTextureSize && texture_size != MaxTextureSize)
4160 throw std::runtime_error("Invalid REALimage texture memory size");
4161 std::array<uint32_t, DMARegisterCount> dma_regs{};
4162 for (uint32_t& reg : dma_regs)
4163 reg = get32(p);
4164 std::array<PlaneState, PlaneCount> planes{};
4165 for (auto& plane : planes)
4166 {
4167 plane.written = get32(p);
4168 plane.unknown_masks = get32(p);
4169 if ((plane.written & ~(large ? 0xffffffffu : 0x0fffffffu)) ||
4170 plane.unknown_masks > (large ? 255u : 15u))
4171 throw std::runtime_error("Invalid REALimage plane register mask");
4172 const unsigned registers = large ? PlaneRegisterCount : LegacyPlaneRegisterCount;
4173 for (unsigned i = 0; i < registers; ++i)
4174 {
4175 plane.regs[i] = get32(p);
4176 if (!(plane.written & (1u << i)) && plane.regs[i])
4177 throw std::runtime_error("Invalid REALimage plane register state");
4178 }
4179 }
4180 std::array<ClearCache, 3> clear_cache{};
4181 for (unsigned bank = 0; bank < (packed_auxiliary ? 3u : 2u); ++bank)
4182 {
4183 auto& cache = clear_cache[bank];
4184 cache.source = get32(p);
4185 cache.color = get32(p);
4186 cache.known = get32(p);
4187 if ((cache.source & ~0x07ff07ffu) ||
4188 (version < 16 && bank < 2 && (cache.known & 0xff000000)) ||
4189 (cache.color & ~cache.known) || (!cache.known && cache.source))
4190 throw std::runtime_error("Invalid REALimage clear cache");
4191 }
4192 Pending readback;
4193 if (version >= 10)
4194 {
4195 readback.x = get32(p);
4196 readback.y = get32(p);
4197 readback.width = get32(p);
4198 readback.height = get32(p);
4199 readback.word = get32(p);
4200 readback.banks = get32(p);
4201 if ((readback.width && (pending.width || !readback.height ||
4202 readback.x >= m_color_width || readback.y >= m_color_height ||
4203 readback.width > m_color_width - readback.x ||
4204 readback.height > m_color_height - readback.y ||
4205 readback.word >= uint64_t(readback.width) * readback.height ||
4206 (readback.banks != 1 && readback.banks != 2))) ||
4207 (!readback.width && (readback.x || readback.y || readback.height ||
4208 readback.word || readback.banks)))
4209 throw std::runtime_error("Invalid REALimage readback state");
4210 }
4211 std::array<uint32_t, 256> pal{};
4212 for (auto& c : pal)
4213 {
4214 c = get32(p);
4215 if (c & 0xff000000)
4216 throw std::runtime_error("Invalid palette encoding");
4217 }
4218 std::vector<uint8_t> dac_regs(DACRegisterCount);
4219 p.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(dac_regs.data()), dac_regs.size());
4220 const uint32_t count = get32(p);
4221 if (count > MaxShadowRegisters ||
4222 fixed_payload + uint64_t(count) * 8 + texture_size - MinTextureSize != size)
4223 throw std::runtime_error("Invalid REALimage shadow register count");
4224 std::map<uint32_t, uint32_t> shadow;
4225 for (uint32_t i = 0; i < count; ++i)
4226 {
4227 const uint32_t address = get32(p), value = get32(p);
4228 if ((address & 3) || !shadow.emplace(address, value).second)
4229 throw std::runtime_error("Invalid REALimage shadow register");
4230 }
4231 std::vector<uint8_t> memory(VGAMemorySize);
4232 p.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(memory.data()), memory.size());
4233 std::vector<uint32_t> color(m_color_pixels * 2);
4234 for (uint32_t& c : color)
4235 {
4236 c = get32(p);
4237 if (version < 16 && (c & 0xff000000))
4238 throw std::runtime_error("Invalid REALimage color buffer");
4239 }
4240 std::vector<uint32_t> auxiliary(m_color_pixels);
4241 for (uint32_t& word : auxiliary)
4242 {
4243 if (packed_auxiliary)
4244 word = get32(p);
4245 else
4246 {
4247 const int id = p.get();
4248 if (id < 0 || id > 15)
4249 throw std::runtime_error("Invalid REALimage window ID buffer");
4250 word = uint32_t(id) << 12;
4251 }
4252 }
4253 std::vector<uint8_t> texture(texture_size);
4254 p.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(texture.data()), texture.size());
4255 const uint32_t dma_irq_pending = version >= 14 ? get32(p) : 0;
4256 if (dma_irq_pending > 1)
4257 throw std::runtime_error("Invalid REALimage DMA interrupt state");
4258 if (version >= 18)
4259 {
4260 const unsigned groups = large ? 8 : 4;
4261 for (auto& plane : planes)
4262 {
4263 for (unsigned group = 0; group < 8; ++group)
4264 {
4265 const uint32_t written = get32(p);
4266 if (written > 255 || (group >= groups && written))
4267 throw std::runtime_error("Invalid REALimage clear latch mask");
4268 plane.clear_written[group] = uint8_t(written);
4269 }
4270 for (unsigned group = 0; group < 8; ++group)
4271 for (unsigned word = 0; word < 8; ++word)
4272 {
4273 const uint32_t value = get32(p);
4274 if (!(plane.clear_written[group] & (1u << word)) && value)
4275 throw std::runtime_error("Invalid REALimage clear latch state");
4276 plane.clear_colors[group][word] = value;
4277 }
4278 }
4279 const auto draw = shadow.find(DrawControl);
4280 const uint32_t format = draw == shadow.end() ? 0 : draw->second & 255,
4281 width = format == 2 ? 8 : format == 3 && large ? 16 : 0;
4282 for (auto& cache : clear_cache)
4283 {
4284 const uint32_t patterned = get32(p);
4285 if (patterned > 1 || (patterned && (!width || !cache.known)))
4286 throw std::runtime_error("Invalid REALimage clear pattern state");
4287 cache.patterned = patterned != 0;
4288 bool uniform = true;
4289 for (unsigned i = 0; i < cache.pattern.size(); ++i)
4290 {
4291 const uint32_t value = get32(p);
4292 if ((!patterned || i >= width * 4) ? value != 0 : (value & ~cache.known) != 0)
4293 throw std::runtime_error("Invalid REALimage clear pattern value");
4294 if (i < width * 4 && value != cache.color)
4295 uniform = false;
4296 cache.pattern[i] = value;
4297 }
4298 if (patterned && (cache.pattern[0] != cache.color || uniform))
4299 throw std::runtime_error("Invalid REALimage clear pattern encoding");
4300 }
4301 }
4302 if (version >= 20)
4303 {
4304 pending.auxiliary_compare_mask = get32(p);
4305 pending.auxiliary_reference = get32(p);
4306 if ((pending.auxiliary_reference & ~pending.auxiliary_compare_mask) ||
4307 (pending.auxiliary_compare_mask && (pending.auxiliary_compare_mask != 0x8000 ||
4308 !pending.width || (pending.banks != 1 && pending.banks != 2) ||
4309 pending.x >= m_color_width || pending.y >= m_color_height ||
4310 pending.width > m_color_width - pending.x ||
4311 pending.height > m_color_height - pending.y)))
4312 throw std::runtime_error("Invalid REALimage upload comparison state");
4313 }
4314 if (!p || p.peek() != std::char_traits<char>::eof())
4315 throw std::runtime_error("Invalid REALimage snapshot payload");
4316 // Commit only after validation; keep the storage vga_device borrows in place.
4317 std::copy(memory.begin(), memory.end(), m_vga_memory.begin());
4318 m_palette = pal;
4319 m_dac_regs.swap(dac_regs);
4320 m_shadow.swap(shadow);
4321 m_color.swap(color);
4322 m_auxiliary.swap(auxiliary);
4323 m_texture.swap(texture);
4324 m_dma_regs = dma_regs;
4325 m_dma_irq_pending = dma_irq_pending != 0;
4326 m_planes = planes;
4327 m_clear_cache = clear_cache;
4328 m_pending = pending;
4329 m_readback = readback;
4330 m_warned.clear();
4331 m_aperture_warned = m_shadow_full_warned = false;
4332 m_unit_reset = unit_reset;
4333 m_interrupt_enable = interrupt_enable;
4334 m_vga_control = vga_control;
4335 m_display_control = display_control;
4336 m_status_phase = status_phase;
4337 m_frame_counter = uint16_t(frame_counter);
4338 m_board_control = uint8_t(board_control);
4339 m_board_io = board_io;
4340 m_board_timing = uint8_t(board_timing);
4341 m_io_index = index;
4342 m_dac_index = uint16_t(dac);
4343 m_dac_component = uint8_t(dac_component);
4344 m_palette_read = uint8_t(rd);
4345 m_palette_write = uint8_t(wr);
4346 update_irq();
4347}
